)

NOW HIRING: Experienced B2B Appointment Setters & Outbound Sales Representatives



**100% Remote | Work From Home | Uncapped Commissions**



🌎 **Hiring Worldwide — Philippines, Dominican Republic, Colombia & More!**



Capital Resolution Network (CRN) is a U.S.-based financial services company specializing in Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) funding and business debt resolution.



We're seeking **experienced outbound sales representatives, B2B cold callers, and appointment setters** who know how to engage business owners, handle objections, and generate qualified opportunities.



**This is not an entry-level position.** We're looking for motivated sales professionals who are comfortable working independently and earning based on performance.



💼 POSITION DETAILS



**Position:** B2B Outbound Sales Representative / Appointment Setter



**Location:** 100% Remote — Worldwide



**Compensation:** Commission Only + Performance Bonuses



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | Flexible 8-Hour Shifts



## 🕘 FLEXIBLE WORK SCHEDULE — U.S. EASTERN TIME



Our operating hours are **9:00 AM – 9:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (New York Time).**



- **Minimum 8 working hours per day.**



- Choose your preferred 8-hour shift within our 12-hour operating window.

- Want to work more than 8 hours? You're welcome to work additional hours within the operating window.

- Flexible start and finish times, provided you meet your daily activity and performance requirements.

- All schedules follow U.S. Eastern Time, regardless of your country of residence.



**Example schedules:**



- 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

- 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET

- 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM ET

- 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM ET



**We focus on productivity and results, not micromanagement.** As long as you're meeting your responsibilities, maintaining professional communication, and delivering consistent results, you'll have the independence to manage your workday.



🎯 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners using company-provided leads.

- Identify businesses seeking working capital or MCA debt relief.

- Qualify interested merchants and schedule appointments.

- Handle objections and build relationships with decision-makers.

- Assist with collecting application information.

- Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-ups.

- Meet a minimum target of 250 outbound call attempts daily.



💰 COMPENSATION — UNLIMITED EARNING POTENTIAL



**100% Performance-Based | No Base Salary | No Commission Cap**



Earn commissions and performance bonuses for:



- Achieving verified weekly calling targets.

- Qualified business funding applications.

- Qualified MCA debt-resolution applications.

- Successfully enrolled debt-resolution clients.

- Successfully funded business transactions.



Your earning potential is directly tied to your performance. Full compensation details are provided during the interview.



✅ WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Company-provided U.S. business leads.

- CRM and dialing tools.

- Structured training and onboarding.

- Sales scripts and objection-handling resources.

- Ongoing support from our U.S.-based team.

- Flexible remote work opportunities.

- Career growth and leadership opportunities.



🔥 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- At least 1 year of outbound sales or appointment-setting experience preferred.

- Experience with U.S. B2B cold-calling campaigns.

- Strong, conversational English communication skills.

- Confidence handling objections and speaking with business owners.

- Experience using CRM systems.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet performance targets.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and quality headset.



**Experience in MCA funding, business lending, debt resolution, insurance, solar, or BPO outbound sales is a major advantage.**



Spanish-speaking candidates are encouraged to apply.



📩 HOW TO APPLY



*
:** 



**Subject:** Experienced Appointment Setter – [Your Full Name]



Please include:



1. Full name and country of residence.

2. Resume or summary of outbound sales experience.

3. A 30–60 second English voice introduction.

4. Previous U.S. sales campaigns you've worked on.

5. Your average daily outbound call volume and weekly appointments booked.

6. Your preferred 8-hour shift between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



**Priority consideration will be given to applicants with proven U.S. B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.**



🌐 



**Capital Resolution Network (CRN)**



*Work remotely. Set your schedule. Get rewarded for your performance.*

title: Nerd Culture Content Review
description:
We are looking for members to join our review team for our future media site currently in development. We are looking for fans who are very passionate about their fandoms, and are willing to watch, listen or read the content, and then review them for the site. Reviews can be both written and in video form. 



I need to be very clear about this: you must be a PASSIONATE fan about what it is you want to review for us. We will be interviewing very strictly on what you claim to love as we only want the most passionate and excited fans to join this team. This job will also eventually begin podcasting as well, so you will be included on this when the time comes. 



We are searching for reviewers and content creators in all of the following genres:



- Anime (all subgenres. What do you love watching?)

- Gaming (all subgenres. What do you love playing)

- Manga (all subgenres. What do you enjoy reading)

- Super Hero Comics (All series and characters. Who do you know the best, and who can you talk about at length?)

- Sci Fi (All subgenres. What do you like to watch?)

- Korean Music (K-Pop specifically, but all genres. Who can you talk about at length? Who do you stan?)

- Japanese Music (J-Pop/J-Rock/Anime/Gaming, etc. We want it all. What can you talk at length about?)



Crossovers are welcome. If you have multiple fandoms that you love, please let us know about them.  WE WILL TEST YOU! There will be phone and video interviews to get an idea of who you are and how you mix with us, as well as to hear you speak about what you say you love. Again, we want to be thorough, and we want you to LOVE your fandom.



This will be a full-time job! You will be required to submit content regularly, depending on what you're reviewing. For instance, if you say you are an Anime fan, you will be required to watch anime...which you should already be doing anyway! Take notes on what you're watching and look at your shows from not only a fan's perspective, but also from the perspective of someone who is brand new and may have never seen or heard of the show you're watching. You will be reviewing every episode as they come out! Therefore, you need to have TIME to do this job! The review format will be very thorough, so if you do not like to write, this will not work for you! Copy and paste this example to literally every other genre we've listed. It applies across the board!



If you're still here and are serious about this, we thank you. To prove you read everything and are able to follow instructions, please include the phrase "So you're looking for Super Fans...Mission Accepted" in the title of your response.  This is A MASSIVE operation we are launching, and while we have a lot of space for a lot of members, we only want those who will dedicate themselves to this cause. We thank everyone who applies, and good luck to you all!

title: AI VIDEO AD EDITORS WANTED: $5/hr + 10% OF EVERY SALE YOUR AD MAKES
description:
STEP 1 (MANDATORY): WATCH THIS VIDEO BEFORE YOU DO ANYTHING ELSE





If you don't watch the video, you will not be hired. No exceptions.

Everything you need to know about how this works, how you get paid, and what we expect is in that video. Somewhere in it, I say a secret word. Put that word in the first line of your application. Applications without it get deleted without being read.



---



You've made ads that made other people rich. This time, you get a cut.



Right now, somewhere, an ad you edited is still making money for a brand that paid you once and forgot your name. You got $20, $30, maybe $50. They got the sales.



We think that's backwards.



CORVIA is a fast-growing heart-health supplement brand. We're building a team of 100 AI video ad editors, and we're paying them like partners. We run your ad with our money. If it sells, you earn 10% of every sale it brings in, for as long as it keeps selling.



AI ISN'T COMING FOR YOUR JOB HERE. IT'S YOUR WEAPON.



Everyone is scared AI will replace editors. We think the opposite. The editors who master AI tools and understand what makes people buy are about to be the most valuable people in advertising. We want those people, and we'll pay them like it.



HOW IT WORKS



1. We give you the inspiration. Proven winning ads from our market, the hooks that work, and a clear brief. No guessing, no blank page.

2. You make it better. Keep the psychology and the story that already sells, then add CORVIA's unique mechanism, sharper hooks and stronger AI visuals. Then make your own originals.

3. We test it with real money. The best ads go live at $100/day in ad spend.

4. Winners scale, and so do you. If your ad keeps bringing in customers at our target cost, we keep raising the budget. More spend means more sales, and more commission for you.



WHAT ONE WINNING AD CAN BE WORTH TO YOU



- Ad scaled to $1,000/day in spend: about $2,700/month in commission

- Ad scaled to $5,000/day: about $13,600/month

- Ad scaled to $10,000/day: about $27,000/month



That's from one ad, and you can have several running at once. These are examples, not promises: most ads won't win. The ones that do pay like nothing else in this industry.



PAY



- $5/hour base while you create (up to 4 hours per ad), so you're paid from day one

- 10% commission on net sales from every ad of yours we run

- Extra commission when you make variations of a winning ad

- Paid twice a month, on fixed dates, via Wise or Payoneer

- You can see how your ads are selling, so you never have to wonder what you're owed



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Make 1 AI video ad per day, from 30 seconds to 5 minutes

- Remake proven winners into better CORVIA versions, then create your own

- Build hooks and variations of our current winning ads

- Formats: AI UGC-style, AI presenter, B-roll story ads, character skits (sitcom, story-driven)

- Follow our ad rules: no fake doctors, no fake customer reviews, no disease claims. We'll train you on them.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU



- Have made short-form or direct-response ads before

- Use AI video tools like Arcads, HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, CapCut or Premiere

- Know a hook from a headline, and know why people stop scrolling

- Can ship every day, take feedback, and want to be measured on results

- Have strong English and reliable internet



HOW TO GET PICKED



We only take the best. Here's how to show us:



1. WATCH THE LOOM VIDEO: 
  This is mandatory. Put the secret word from the video in the first line of your application.

2. Send your 3 best ads. Real ads you made, with links, plus any results you know (views, ROAS, sales).

3. List the AI tools you use and how fast you can turn around an ad.

4. Shortlisted editors get a paid test ($5 an hour for the first week . We send you a winning ad, and you make a better one for CORVIA. 

5. The best tests get hired. You start making ads that week.



No secret word = no review. That's how we know who's serious.



You already know how to make ads that sell. Come make some that pay you.

title: Strategic FBA Sourcing Partner – Amazon UK Online Arbitrage (Growth & Leadership Opportunity)
description:
Title: Strategic FBA Sourcing Partner – Amazon UK Online Arbitrage (Growth & Leadership Opportunity) 



About Us

Summitline Ltd is a newly established, aggressively funded UK-based e-commerce business. We are launching on Day 1 with a substantial upfront capital deployment of £5,000, scaling rapidly to £15k+ within the first five months. Backed by robust backend infrastructure, including an established UK prep centre contract and automated software suites, we are skipping the hobbyist phase entirely. 



We are not looking for a basic data-entry worker or a low-level scraper. We are looking for a highly strategic Sourcing Partner who wants to come on board from Day 1, take ownership of our inventory pipeline, and grow alongside the company. For the right individual who can consistently drive the business forward, this role is designed to evolve into a long-term profit-sharing partnership with significant financial upside on top of your base salary. 



Requirements 



* Proven track record in Amazon UK Online Arbitrage with deep strategic understanding of market velocity.

* Complete mastery of Keepa (reading advanced charts, buy box rotation, price stability) and SellerAmp SAS.

* Exceptional analytical skills – you know how to protect capital, avoid IP claims, and spot long-term seasonal trends.

* Excellent written and spoken English with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

* Flawless management of Google Sheets and inventory tracking data.

* Highly reliable internet connection, power backup, and availability to communicate during UK daytime hours.

* Willingness to record a short video demonstrating your sourcing/analysis process.



Your Strategic Daily Responsibilities 



* Lead the sourcing infrastructure by executing deep manual and automated scans across UK retail networks.

* Evaluate deals through a strict capital-preservation lens (targeting high-velocity items that protect our upfront investments).

* Populate and manage our Master Sourcing Sheet with comprehensive metrics (ASIN, Source Link, Amazon Price, ROI, and Estimated Monthly Sales).

* Actively filter and highlight premium leads that exceed our strict baseline criteria (Min 30% ROI after factoring in prep costs).

* Collaborate directly with the Founder to optimize buying depth (d
 how many units to buy based on competition and sales history).



What We Offer 



* A premium, stable base monthly salary tailored to your experience level.

* Massive financial upside: We are looking for a true partner. Performance-based incentives and an direct share of net business profits will be unlocked as we clear our initial launch phases.

* Absolute professional autonomy – you will be the driving force behind our inventory strategy.

* Cutting-edge software tools and high-budget purchasing power provided from day one.



How to Apply

To be considered for this founding role, please reply with: 



1. A short introduction explaining why you are looking for a strategic partner role rather than a standard virtual assistant job.

2. A detailed summary of your experience scaling Amazon UK Online Arbitrage accounts.

3. A 2–3  video showing how you analyze a complex Keepa chart and SellerAmp data on a UK product.

4. Your expected hourly or monthly base rate.

5. Your available working hours (stated in UK time).

title: Appointment Setter Wanted: If a Full Calendar Is Your Idea of a Win, Close This Tab
description:
Let's be blunt about what this job is not.



It's not dialing for dials. It's not stacking a calendar so it looks busy. It's not clocking in, clocking out, and collecting a paycheck while the closer cleans up your mess on the call.



Here's what it is: you are the reason our closer opens their day to conversations that can actually close. You find the business. You find the human who can say yes. You qualify hard before you book. And then you stay on it—through the follow-ups, through the no-shows, through the reschedules—until that appointment turns into revenue or dies for a real reason.



If that sounds like your job, keep reading. The next paragraph is where most people get filtered out.



Read this before you apply

We get a lot of applications. Plenty of them are from people who never read the post. Plenty more are from VA agencies quietly trying to place one of their people into our role. To be clear: we hire individuals only. We do not work with VA companies, and we won't entertain agency placements.



So here's your first test, and yes, it's silly on purpose:



Is a hot dog a sandwich? Answer in one line.



Put your answer in your application. If it's missing, we know you didn't read this.



What you'll actually own

Research and targeting. You learn the businesses we serve, understand what they're up against, and shape your approach around the client avatar instead of a generic script.



Decision-maker access. You get past the gatekeeper to the person who can actually approve the next step.



Qualification. Fit, need, timing, authority. You book the ones worth booking—and you're comfortable saying no to the rest.



Cold
 outreach and follow-up. You can open a cold conversation and keep it alive without becoming noise. Your follow-up is deliberate, not a
.



Recovery as a priority. No-show, cancellation, reschedule? That gets handled first, not whenever there's time. Protecting the closer's calendar is part of the job.



GoHighLevel hygiene. Clean records, useful notes, nothing left for the closer to guess at.



AI tools in your workflow. You use them to move faster and work smarter—research, personalization, follow-up—not as a crutch.



Slack, all day. It's our communication channel for everything: updates, questions, market feedback, lead-quality flags. Not
, not side threads.



A real end-of-day report in Slack. Outreaches made. Appointments on the calendar. Goals hit. What the closer needs to know before tomorrow.



Your own day. No hovering, no hourly check-ins. We don't micromanage. But we're paying close attention to the calendar, the pipeline, and the results—so don't mistake quiet for absent.



What we need from you

5+ years of B2B appointment setting, with provable work history and references who will vouch for it.



A track record of qualified sets, not dial volume. You can walk us through conversations, qualified appointments, meetings held, and closed business.



Proficiency in GoHighLevel, AI tools, and cold
 outreach — plus the core appointment-setting skills: prospect research and decision-maker identification, multi-channel outreach (phone,
, LinkedIn), early objection handling, qualification before booking, speed-to-lead response, appointment confirmation and reminder discipline to protect show rate, structured multi-touch follow-up, and clean CRM and pipeline management.



Strong written and spoken English.



Dependability and a serious work ethic.



High-speed internet with a backup. Momentum can't stall because your connection did.



A team-first mindset. Your bonus is tied to closed business from your appointments, so the closer winning is you winning.



What you submit

Your resume.



A voice recording introducing yourself. Tell us who you are, your appointment setting background, and the results you can prove. This is required. No recording, no consideration.



Proof of results. Numbers, campaigns, references—whatever backs up what you're claiming.



Your answer to the hot dog question.



If you're looking for a place to clock in and collect a check, this isn't it. We're not interested, and you'll be happier somewhere else.



If you're the real thing, this role pays accordingly: base plus an uncapped bonus tied to closed business from the appointments you source.



Send it all through the application. We read everything—including the one-liners.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Our Instagram Has Been Dead for a Year. We're Hiring the Person Who Brings It Back — and We're Judging on Money, Not Likes.                                                                                                                                                                                                               Here's the hook: if "posting to post" is your thing, close this tab. We need someone who turns content into conversations our appointment setters can book, and our salespeople can close. That's the whole job.



Quick filter, silly on purpose: Does pineapple belong on pizza? One line in your application. No answer means you didn't read this.



Why this seat carries weight: long before a setter gets a reply or a closer gets a call, the prospect has already formed an opinion of us from what they found online. Everything you publish is the first impression, the credibility check, and often the d
 factor in whether a deal gets a chance to happen at all. If the content is weak, the pipeline behind it never gets tested. That's the leverage in this role — and it's why we're hiring carefully rather than quickly.



There's a second job underneath that one: earning attention from people who owe us nothing. Every day, a business owner's feed is packed with competitors, personalities, and brands all fighting for the same eyeballs. We want posts that get picked up and pushed out by the platform on their own merit, pull strangers onto our pages because the content was worth following for, and turn casual viewers into people who recognize us before a single message is sent. That doesn't happen by a
 and it doesn't happen with filler. It happens when someone has spent years learning exactly how the platforms reward content — and knows that a scroll decision gets made in a couple of seconds, with nothing but a thumbnail and an opening beat to earn it.



What the job actually is

Two channels, two businesses. You'll run social for a wellness brand and an AI brand — separate audiences, separate voices, separate strategies. They don't get to look alike or sound alike.



Own the channel strategy. Every platform we're on, why we're on it, what it's for, and how it connects to revenue. You build the plan and defend it with reasoning, not trends.



Earn attention first. Your openings have to win the scroll in the first couple of seconds, every time, because that's all the room there is in a crowded feed. No slow builds, no burying the point.



Run the calendar. Concept, brief, produce, publish, schedule, and keep the pipeline of content full without being chased.



Make the content. Short-form video, UGC-style pieces, graphics, carousels, copy, captions, hooks — you can produce across formats, not just one lane.



Build the
 assets. Our appointment setters run outreach by
, and they need visuals to go with it — images, graphics, and supporting assets. You produce those. You're not writing their sequences or sending their campaigns; you're making sure they always have something good to send.



Keep it all in GoHighLevel. Everything you produce gets organized inside GHL's content library so a setter mid-outreach can find the right asset in seconds instead of messaging you and waiting. That's a big part of why GHL fluency matters in this role.



Rebuild and grow the audience we actually want. A following made of the businesses and decision-makers we serve. Not random accounts with no reason to buy.



Own community and DMs. Respond, engage, start conversations, and hand warm interest to the setters with context so nothing sits cold.



Make our profiles convert. Bio, highlights, pinned posts, link paths — when a prospect checks us out before a call, the page should sell us for you.



Track and report inside GoHighLevel. Reach, engagement, profile visits, inbound conversations, lead sources, leads handed off. You know which numbers matter and which are decoration, and you can show attribution in GHL instead of guessing.



Work with the sales side. You sit with our setters and closers on messaging, objections, and what's converting — and you adjust content based on what they hear on calls.



Communicate in Slack, all day. Slack is where our team runs. Updates, questions, wins, blockers, and anything the team needs to know live there — not in scattered
s or side threads.



Post a real end-of-day report in Slack. What you published, what you produced, what's performing, goals hit, what's next, and where you need the team's input.



Test and kill. Try things, measure them, keep what works, cut what doesn't, and tell us why.



Bring the playbook. The thinking behind how Gary Vee, Alex Hormozi, and Russell Brunson turned attention into revenue — hook psychology, offer clarity, funnel thinking, volume — applied to us instead of quoted at us.



You'll also work across YouTube and Skool as part of that mix, and you'll be producing UGC-style content with tools like Higgsfield, Canva, and CapCut, with AI built into how you work.



Read this before you apply

Plenty of applicants never read the post. Plenty more are agencies trying to place someone into the role. We hire individuals only — no VA companies, no agency placements.



What we need from you

5+ years in social media marketing.



3+ years as an active GoHighLevel user. You've actually worked in GHL — content library, pipelines, lead tracking, attribution — not just heard of it.



A portfolio we can verify that's still live today. Active accounts, working links, real engagement. Dormant profiles and dead sites don't count as proof.



A provable track record of growth and revenue, not just audience size. A marketing degree is a plus; results matter more.



Fluency in UGC production and the tools behind it — Higgsfield, Canva, CapCut — plus comfort with AI in your workflow.



Strong written English, self-direction, and high-speed internet with a backup.



Slack proficiency, since that's where the team operates.



A revenue-generator's mindset. You think like someone who owns a number, because you'll be measured like one. You will also receive a bonus on revenue/sales that came from your social media content. 



Tools

You'll have what you need to do the job from day one. Higgsfield, Canva, CapCut, and the AI tools in your workflow are provided by us — we expect proficiency because you'll be using them starting your first week. If you already have your own stack you're excellent with and would rather keep working in it, that's your call, and we're fine with it. What we care about is output, not subscriptions. And as the channels grow, we'll keep investing in whatever helps you take them further.



What you submit

Your resume.



Live links to accounts you've worked on. Active, verifiable, with engagement worth showing. Broken links end the application.



Results — growth and revenue those accounts produced, how you tracked it, and where GHL fit into that tracking.



Your answer to the pineapple question.



If you're here to make pretty posts, we'll pass. If you can build channels that put qualified buyers in front of our sales team, we want to see your work.

description:

 content operations to ensure all published materials are engaging, accurate, consistent with brand guidelines, and compliant with applicable legal advertising standards.



The ideal candidate has strong content management, editorial, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage content workflows, and develop high-quality content that strengthens brand awareness, increases audience engagement, and supports the firm’s overall marketing objectives.

4.

 content with broader marketing campaigns, editorial calendars, and brand-specific objectives.



Ensure all
 communications are accurate, engaging, professionally written, and consistent with established brand guidelines.



Review
 content for clarity, formatting, quality, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.



Manage
 content schedules and coordinate with relevant team members to ensure timely distribution.



Monitor
 marketing performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and content effectiveness.



5. Content Strategy, Quality Control, and Compliance



Track immigration news, including USCIS and State Department updates, the Visa Bulletin, policy changes, court decisions, processing-time shifts and fee changes. D
 quickly what deserves coverage and how fast.



Develop and maintain consistent content standards across social media, blogs, videos, and
 communications.

Qualifications and Requirements

At least 3 years of experience in content marketing, social media management, digital content production, or a related role.

Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.

Proficiency with social media scheduling and management tools, such as Hootsuite or Buffer.

Familiarity with
 marketing platforms, such as Mailchimp or ConvertKit.

title: Outbound Sales & Client Acquisition Virtual Assistant (B2B Services)
description:
We are a growing US-based professional services company seeking a dependable, proactive, and results-driven Virtual Assistant to manage inbound communications, outbound sales, lead management, and client acquisition activities.



We provide recurring business services to small and medium-sized businesses, including companies operating in logistics, transportation, and third-party logistics (3PL).



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the client acquisition process, from initial prospect contact through successful enrollment and onboarding.



This is not an appointment-setting-only position. We need someone who is comfortable speaking with business owners, identifying opportunities, conducting discovery conversations, following up consistently, and helping convert qualified prospects into paying customers.



Our business management team operates on nontraditional schedules and may not always be immediately available during standard business hours. As such, we are seeking a dependable, self-directed professional who can independently manage day-to-day communications, maintain consistent follow-up with prospective clients, and keep business operations moving without requiring constant supervision.



The ideal candidate demonstrates sound judgment, takes initiative, and knows when matters require management escalation.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inbound Call Management & Customer Communication



Answer incoming business calls professionally using our cloud-based phone system.



Respond to inquiries from prospective and existing customers.



Return missed calls and manage callback requests promptly.



Qualify incoming sales opportunities and assist callers with appropriate next steps.



Schedule consultations when necessary.



Document customer conversations, requests, and follow-up needs.



Ensure customer inquiries receive timely attention during assigned working hours.



2. Outbound Sales & Prospecting



Conduct outbound cold calls to US-based business owners and decision-makers.



Work from targeted prospect lists provided by the company.



Research and verify prospect contact information when necessary.



Introduce our services and identify potential business needs.



Navigate gatekeepers and communicate confidently with decision-makers.



Generate qualified sales opportunities through consistent outreach.



Maintain organized records of calling activity and prospect responses.



3. Discovery, Qualification & Client Acquisition



Conduct structured discovery conversations to understand prospective clients' needs.



Determine whether prospects meet established qualification criteria.



Explain approved service packages, pricing, and available solutions.



Address common questions and objections professionally.



Guide qualified prospects toward scheduling, proposal review, or enrollment.



Confidently ask interested prospects to move forward.



Escalate unusual service requests, custom pricing, or nonstandard agreements to management.



4. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



Maintain accurate and organized prospect records.



Track leads through each stage of the sales process.



Schedule and manage follow-up activities.



Monitor outstanding proposals, pending decisions, and incomplete enrollment steps.



Update lead statuses and document important conversations.



Identify inactive opportunities and follow established procedures for closing out or reactivating leads.



Ensure no qualified prospect is overlooked.



5. Sales Follow-Up & Conversion



Follow up with interested prospects through phone,
, and approved messaging channels.



Monitor automated follow-up sequences and respond to inquiries.



Encourage prospective clients to take the next step using approved offers and enrollment links.



Assist customers with scheduling consultations and completing enrollment requirements.



Maintain consistent communication until a prospect converts, declines, or is removed from the active pipeline.



6. Client Onboarding Coordination



Send approved engagement letters and onboarding instructions.



Monitor completion of electronic agreements.



Coordinate initial payment setup and confirm enrollment status.



Request necessary client information and documentation through approved secure systems.



Follow up on incomplete onboarding requirements.



Organize client records and prepare completed onboarding files for service delivery.



Communicate onboarding status and outstanding issues to management.



7. Process Improvement & Reporting



Assist with establishing and improving sales and administrative workflows.



Help create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation.



Provide daily summaries of calls, leads, follow-ups, and appointments.



Prepare weekly reports on sales pipeline activity, qualified opportunities, and new client acquisitions.



Communicate challenges, recommendations, and issues requiring management attention.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 1 year of experience in B2B cold calling, sales development, or client acquisition.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Previous experience communicating with US-based customers or business owners.



Confidence handling both inbound and outbound business calls.



Experience conducting discovery conversations, qualifying prospects, and following up on sales opportunities.



Familiarity with CRM software, cloud-based phone systems, and online scheduling tools.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Professional communication skills and good judgment.



Reliable high-speed internet connection, quality headset, and quiet working environment.



Availability during assigned US Central Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience selling professional services or recurring subscription-based services.



Experience supporting companies in logistics, transportation, 3PL, or related service industries.



Experience with Quo (formerly OpenPhone) or similar cloud-based business phone systems.



Familiarity with CRM automation,
 sequences, and digital client onboarding.



Experience working directly with US-based small-business owners.



Experience developing SOPs and improving operational processes.



Compensation & Performance Incentives



Base Salary: $500 USD per month



This is a part-time position requiring approximately 20 hours per week.



In addition to the guaranteed base salary, we offer performance-based compensation designed to reward successful client acquisition.



New Client Acquisition Bonus: $40 USD per client



A successful client acquisition is defined as a new customer who:



Signs an engagement agreement.



Successfully completes their initial payment.



Remains an active client for at least 30 days.



Once these requirements are satisfied, the $40 bonus is earned and paid with the next scheduled payroll.



There is no cap on the number of client acquisition bonuses that can be earned.



Example Monthly Earnings



Base salary only: $500



Base salary + 3 new clients: $620



Base salary + 5 new clients: $700



Base salary + 10 new clients: $900



Base salary + 15 new clients: $1,100



Examples assume all listed client bonuses become payable during the same month.



Compensation and performance will be reviewed after the initial 60–90 days. Opportunities for increased compensation, additional responsibilities, and expanded hours may be available as the business grows.



What Success Looks Like



We are seeking someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and consistently keeps business activities moving.



Successful performance includes:



Answering incoming calls reliably during assigned coverage hours.



Maintaining consistent outbound prospecting activity.



Responding promptly to prospective customers.



Generating and qualifying legitimate sales opportunities.



Following up with interested prospects without needing reminders.



Keeping the CRM and sales pipeline accurate and organized.



Helping convert qualified opportunities into paying clients.



Coordinating onboarding activities efficiently.



Communicating proactively with management.



We value quality, consistency, initiative, and results over inflated call counts or unnecessary activity.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working independently, solving problems, and contributing directly to the growth of a business.



What We Provide



Targeted prospect lists for outbound calling.



Access to a cloud-based business phone system.



Approved service offerings and pricing guidelines.



Sales scripts, discovery frameworks, and qualification criteria developed during onboarding.



Access to necessary scheduling, CRM, and administrative tools.



Clear performance expectations and management support.



Opportunities to help develop and improve business processes.



Long-term growth potential.



How to Apply



Please submit the following information:



Introduction: Briefly describe your professional background and relevant experience.



Sales Experience: Describe your experience making outbound B2B cold calls to US businesses.



Results: Share an example of how you helped generate qualified leads, book appointments, or acquire paying customers.



Tools: List the CRM platforms, business phone systems, and scheduling tools you have used.



Compensation: Confirm that you understand the $500 USD monthly base salary for 20 hours per week, plus performance bonuses.



Availability: Confirm your availability to work during US Central Time business hours.



Voice Recording: Submit a 60–90 second audio recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would open a cold call to a US small-business owner.



Important Application Instruction:



Begin your application with the phrase "Client Growth Specialist" so we know you have read the entire job description.



We are looking for a motivated, dependable professional who is interested in building a long-term working relationship and contributing to the growth of a US-based business.

title: B2B Partnerships Manager — US Market
description:
About Hatsy



Hatsy is a US headwear brand making the best hat in the world: every hat is lined with silk, which is better for hair, scalp and skin, and more comfortable than anything else on the market. Our tagline is Inside Matters. We're content- and community-driven, and we're expanding into a full headwear line.

Until now we sold online only. With our supply chain now solved, we're opening a brand-new B2B channel — and we see it as one of the biggest drivers of awareness and revenue for Hatsy going forward.



The role



We're hiring an experienced B2B Partnerships Manager to build and own Hatsy's US B2B channel from the ground up. You'll find, pitch, close, onboard and manage two types of partners: service centers (dermatology clinics, hair salons, wellness centers) and retailers (department stores like Nordstrom and Bloomingdale's, boutiques, mall stores).

The core of this role is finding and closing the right partners. Hatsy is a premium brand, and every location that carries us reflects on it. You'll source partners that match our brand — reputable, well-reviewed, upscale or design-led businesses, never low-tier or off-brand locations — reach them through every channel including the phone, represent Hatsy the way we would, and close the deal. We need someone who already understands the US B2B market deeply and has done exactly this before.

This is a full-time, fully remote position working US hours. You'll report directly to the founders. Our initial focus markets are New York, Los Angeles and Miami, where we have team members who can visit partners in person when needed.



What you'll own



1. Service center partner portals

Service centers — dermatology clinics, hair salons, hair-loss specialists, wellness centers and spas — recommend Hatsy to their clients after a treatment or service, as a better alternative to the hat they'd usually wear.

Each partner gets one display set of hats (one of each style) and its own branded page on our website, for example 
/portals/drdorfman, with custom hero images of their location. Clients try a hat on in person, then buy through the portal. The partner holds no inventory and handles no payments, and clients can browse the full range.

You'll be the lead on this program end to end: finding and pitching centers, closing them, onboarding them (display set, portal setup, staff talking points), and monitoring each partner's performance.



2. Retail placement

The goal is to put Hatsy in front of everyday consumers in physical stores — department stores (Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's), independent boutiques, concept stores and mall retailers — ideally with our own section and branded name card.

Here we ship stock to the store. You'll research and prioritize accounts, find the right buyers, pitch and negotiate, and manage the relationship through first order, sell-through and reorders. Your job is to convince them that Hatsy is the superior hat and belongs on their floor.



Responsibilities

Prospecting & research

• Build and maintain target lists of service centers and retailers in New York, LA and Miami, then expand to other US cities.

• Identify decision-makers (owners, practice managers, buyers, category managers) and their contact details.

• Vet every account for brand fit (reputation, reviews, clientele, look and feel) before reaching out, then prioritize by size and likelihood to close.



Outreach & closing

• Run multi-channel outreach, including cold calling locations directly by phone, plus
, LinkedIn, Instagram DMs and wholesale platforms.

• Write and refine pitch
s, call scripts and follow-up sequences.

• Lead video calls and presentations; handle objections and negotiate terms.

• Book in-person visits for our local team and brief them before each one.

• Prepare for and pursue department store buyer meetings and vendor onboarding processes.



Onboarding

• Service centers: coordinate the display set shipment, collect photos and details for their portal, work with our web team to launch it, and train staff on how to recommend Hatsy.

• Retailers: manage line sheets, purchase orders, shipping, in-store display and name card setup.



Account management & reporting

• Monitor sales per partner (portal sales and retail sell-through) and flag under-performers early.

• Run regular check-ins, drive reorders and grow each account.

• Keep the CRM complete and up to date — every lead, touchpoint and deal stage.

• Send a weekly pipeline report to the founders: new leads, meetings, deals closed, revenue by partner.

• Feed back what you hear from partners on product, pricing and objections.



Who we're looking for

Must-haves

• 3+ years in B2B sales, wholesale or partnerships, selling to US businesses — with closed deals you can point to.

• Strong knowledge of the US retail landscape: how department stores, boutiques and independent shops buy, and how to reach their buyers. You can tell a premium, on-brand location from a low-tier one at a glance.

• Proven ability to open doors cold: you've booked meetings with businesses that had never heard of your company, and you're comfortable cold calling locations by phone.

• Persuasive, native-level English, written and spoken, and the polish to represent a premium brand in every
, call and meeting. You're confident on the phone and on camera with American business owners.

• Extremely organized. You live in your CRM, track every follow-up and never let a lead go cold.

• Self-managed and reliable working remotely: you set your own daily targets, hit them and report clearly without being chased.

• Available to work US Eastern Time business hours.



Strong pluses

• Experience selling fashion, accessories, apparel or beauty products wholesale in the US.

• Experience selling into salons, dermatology clinics, med spas or wellness businesses.

• Existing relationships with US department store or boutique buyers.

• Familiarity with wholesale platforms (Faire, NuOrder, Joor) and department store vendor onboarding.

• Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM, Apollo or similar prospecting tools, and Shopify.

• Comfortable building partner-facing materials in Canva or Google Slides.



You'll fit in if you're

• Competitive and driven by results, not activity.

• Genuinely excited by building something new from zero.

• Proud of the product you sell — you'll need to believe Hatsy is the best hat on the market.



What success looks like

Timeframe

Milestone

First 30 days

CRM set up; 150+ qualified targets across NY, LA and Miami; pitch materials and outreach sequences live; first meetings booked

First 60 days

First service center portals live; first retail conversations and samples out

First 90 days

30+ service center portals live and selling; 5+ retail accounts signed; a weekly reporting rhythm the founders rely on

Longer term, you'll grow this into a repeatable channel across the US and a meaningful share of Hatsy's revenue.



Schedule & compensation

• Type: full-time, remote

• Hours: US Eastern Time business hours, Monday to Friday

• Salary: $1,500 USD per month

• Quarterly bonus: performance-based quarterly bonuses, with targets set together in your first month

• Start: as soon as possible

• Equipment: reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, quiet space for calls, webcam and headset



How to apply

We receive many applications, so please follow these steps exactly — applications that skip them won't be reviewed.

1. Start your application with the subject line "Inside Matters – B2B".

2. Tell us about one US B2B deal you closed: who the buyer was, how you got the meeting and what you sold.

3. List the US companies or types of businesses you've sold to, and your typical results (meetings per month, deals closed, revenue).

4. Attach a 2–3 minute video (Loom or similar) in which you introduce yourself, walk us through your US B2B experience, and share real examples of outreach you've done — read out an actual
, call script or DM you've used, and explain how you approach a cold prospect. Real examples only, no templates.

5. Include your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test task and a video interview with the founders.

3. Accounting and tax support – Assisting with accounting records, Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, and other accounting and taxation tasks.

4. Microsoft Excel and administration – Preparing and maintaining spreadsheets, processing information, managing records and completing general administrative duties.

5. Supporting the team and clients – Working with colleagues to complete assignments accurately and on time, helping to resolve queries and providing assistance to the business owner.

The position will offer considerable variety and the opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience of working within a UK accountancy practice.

SOFTWARE WE USE

Our main software packages include:

• Xero – Bookkeeping and accounting

• Moneysoft Payroll Manager – Payroll and CIS

• Microsoft Office 365 – Excel, Word and Outlook

• TaxCalc – Accounts and tax return preparation

Experience with Xero and Microsoft Excel would be particularly valuable.

Experience with Moneysoft Payroll Manager, TaxCalc or other UK accounting and payroll software would be an advantage.

We do not expect applicants to be familiar with every software package we use, and training and guidance will be provided where appropriate.

Please tell us about your experience with any of these packages or similar products.

OUR REQUIREMENTS

We are particularly interested in applicants who have previous experience working for a UK accountancy practice or providing bookkeeping and payroll services to UK businesses.

Our preferred skills and experience are:

• Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience, ideally involving UK businesses.

• Good working knowledge of Xero, particularly bank reconciliations and transaction processing.

• Experience preparing payroll, preferably UK payroll.

• Good Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.

• Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with colleagues and clients.

Knowledge of UK VAT, Making Tax Digital, PAYE, National Insurance and workplace pensions would be advantageous.

We would also welcome applications from individuals who have worked for accountancy firms outside the UK, particularly where they have relevant bookkeeping or payroll experience.

We appreciate that no applicant will necessarily have experience in every area. We are therefore looking for someone with a good foundation of relevant skills, a willingness to learn and a positive attitude.

Personal qualities are equally important.

We are looking for someone who is reliable, organised, accurate, trustworthy, willing to ask questions when necessary and comfortable working as part of a team.

Confidentiality is essential because you will be working with sensitive financial and personal information.

WORKING HOURS AND REMUNERATION

Working hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week.

We appreciate the time difference between the UK and the Philippines and will be as flexible as reasonably possible when agreeing working hours.

Some overlap with normal UK business hours will be required to allow effective communication with the business owner and other team members.

Salary: Negotiable, depending on relevant experience and skills.

We aim to offer a competitive salary reflecting the successful applicant's experience and responsibilities.

Salary will be reviewed regularly, taking account of performance, development and results achieved.

Our remuneration package also includes a 13th-month payment.

We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship and will provide support and opportunities to develop additional skills and responsibilities.

HOW TO APPLY

If you believe you would be a suitable candidate, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please follow these application instructions carefully.

1. Use a minimum of 10 Apply Points when submitting your application.

2. Include the reference "UK Accountancy VA application" in your application subject line.

3. Provide your CV or a summary of your relevant employment history.

4. Answer the following questions in your application:

Question 1: Have you previously worked for a UK accountancy practice or provided bookkeeping or payroll services to UK businesses? If so, please explain your experience and the type of work you performed.

Question 2: What experience do you have using Xero, particularly bank reconciliations, bookkeeping and VAT preparation?

Question 3: Have you previously prepared UK payroll? If so, which payroll software have you used, and what experience do you have with PAYE, National Insurance, RTI submissions and workplace pensions?

Question 4: Which other accounting, payroll or Microsoft Office software packages have you used?

Question 5: What is your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos (PHP), based on a 37.5-hour working week?

Please ensure that your answers reflect your actual experience. We do not expect every applicant to have experience in all areas.

OUR SELECTION PROCESS

We will review applications and contact candidates whose experience and skills appear suitable for the position.

Due to the number of applications we may receive, we regret that we will not be able to respond individually to unsuccessful applicants.

Our selection process will normally involve:

1. An initial review of your application and experience.

2. An
 exchange to obtain additional information.

3. A short practical assessment of relevant bookkeeping, payroll or administration skills.

4. An online interview with the business owner or other members of our team.

The successful applicant will also be required to provide appropriate official identification and complete any necessary confidentiality and data protection procedures before commencing work.

We look forward to hearing from applicants who would like to become a valued member of our team.

title: Remote Office Manager | Full-Time | Customer Service & Operations
description:
WAGE / SALARY: $900-1,200

JOB OVERVIEW

We're looking for someone who wants to become the person an owner can trust to run the

office.

Catchy Pest Control is a growing pest control company in NYC, and we're hiring our first

dedicated office team member.

The right person will eventually own most of the day-to-day office operation: taking care of

customers, managing the schedule, keeping technicians organized, following up on payments

and leads, and making sure things don't fall through the cracks.

You'll work directly with the owner and learn how the entire business operates.

We're much more interested in finding someone who is sharp, dependable, organized, great

with people, and learns quickly than someone who checks every technical box on day one.

If you're the type of person who naturally takes ownership and figures things out, keep reading.



THE JOB

You'll become the main point person for the day-to-day office side of the business.

You'll own things like:

- Answering customer calls, texts, and
s

- Handling customer questions, concerns, and service issues

- Scheduling and rescheduling services

- Coordinating technician schedules and routes

- Following up with leads and prospective customers

- Following up on failed and overdue payments

- Helping customers with billing questions

- Keeping customer accounts, notes, and records accurate

- Making sure follow-ups and important tasks don't get missed

- Helping with customer retention and review requests



- Keeping company systems and information organized

- Assisting with basic QuickBooks tasks and financial admin

- Helping with basic social media posting and marketing tasks

- Taking on additional office responsibilities as you learn the business

The goal isn't for you to stay an assistant forever.

The goal is for you to learn the business well enough that the owner can increasingly hand you

responsibilities and trust that they're handled.



YOU

You'll probably be a great fit if:

- You speak and write excellent English

- You're confident and professional on the phone

- You're extremely organized

- You're tech-savvy and learn new software quickly

- You take ownership without needing constant follow-up

- You notice when something is wrong and try to solve it

- You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities

- You're comfortable working with numbers and basic financial information

- You communicate quickly and clearly

- You're dependable - if you say you'll do something, it gets done

- You enjoy creating order and keeping things organized

- You want a long-term position where you can earn more responsibility over time

We're looking for someone who can eventually hear: "Can you handle this?" ...and make the

owner's life easier from there.



EXPERIENCE

You should have previous experience in customer service, office administration, operations, or a

similar role.

Experience with any of the following is a bonus:

- QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online

- Bookkeeping or transaction categorization

- Pest control or another home-service business

- Dispatching or route scheduling

- Accounts receivable / collections

- FieldRoutes

- Customer retention



- Sales follow-up

- Social media posting

- Working directly with a small-business owner

QuickBooks experience is NOT required.

If you're comfortable with numbers, tech-savvy, and willing to learn, we can train you on the

QuickBooks responsibilities you'll need for this role.

We'd rather hire an exceptional office manager who can learn QuickBooks than an exceptional

bookkeeper who isn't great at running an office.

THE DEAL

- Full-time

- Remote

- Must be available during 9am-5pm EST business hours

- 900–1,200 USD/month depending on experience

- Performance bonuses

- Paid training

- Long-term position

- Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as the company grows



You'll also need reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer with webcam, and a quiet

place to take customer calls.



WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY IS DIFFERENT

You'll work directly with the owner, learn how the company works, and have the opportunity to

become a major part of the business as it grows.

For the right person, this can become much more than a typical VA position.

We care less about having the perfect resume and more about finding someone who is smart,

reliable, coachable, and takes ownership.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A NEW 3–5 minute Loom video made specifically for this application answering these

questions:

- Give us a quick introduction to yourself.

- Tell us about the most similar role you've had. What were you personally responsible for, and

what could your manager trust you to handle without constantly following up with you?

- Tell us about a time you had several important things happen at once. How did you deal on

what to handle first and make sure nothing got missed?

- Imagine the owner is out in the field and three things happen at the same time: An upset

customer calls, A technician has a scheduling problem, Several overdue customer payments

need follow-up. Walk us through exactly what you would do.

- Why do you believe you'd be a great office hire for a small business where you'll be

expected to take more ownership over time?

Important: Generic or previously recorded Loom videos will not be considered.

To show us you read the entire post, start your application with: "Catchy Pest Control is #1."

title: # Account & Project Manager — Marketing / Web Agency
description:
**Compensation:** $500–$700 USD per month, depending on experience  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, during U.S. Eastern Time business hours  

**Employment Type:** Full-time contractor  

**Application:** Google Form required — link at the bottom



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly proactive, persistent, and organized Account & Project Manager to manage client relationships and coordinate the day-to-day work of our marketing, web development, and design operations.



This is not a passive administrative position. We need someone who takes ownership, communicates constantly, follows up relentlessly, and makes sure people deliver what they promise.



You will sit between our clients and our production team. You will make sure client requests are understood, developers and designers know exactly what to do, deadlines are respected, revisions are completed, and clients receive timely updates.



**Your job is to keep things moving.** If a developer is not responding, you follow up. If a client has not provided information, you chase them. If a deadline is approaching, you check progress before someone has to ask you. If a task is incomplete, you make sure it gets finished.



We need someone who can manage people, handle difficult conversations professionally, and keep multiple projects moving without needing constant supervision from the owner.



## What You Will Be Responsible For



### 1. Client Communication and Account Management



- Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.

- Communicate professionally and confidently through Slack,
, and other agreed-upon channels.

- Respond promptly to client messages and make sure no request gets overlooked.

- Keep clients informed about project progress, outstanding questions, revisions, and deadlines.

- Follow up with clients who have not responded, provided materials, approved designs, or completed necessary steps.

- Handle demanding, frustrated, or difficult clients calmly and professionally.

- Set clear expectations, communicate delays honestly, and help resolve problems before they escalate.

- Make clients feel that their projects are being actively managed and that someone is accountable.



### 2. Persistent Follow-Up and Accountability



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



- Follow up consistently with developers, designers, marketers, clients, and other stakeholders.

- Do not assume a task is being handled simply because someone said they would do it.

- Chase outstanding tasks and unanswered messages until there is a clear response or resolution.

- Follow up before deadlines—not after deadlines have already been missed.

- Keep track of promises, commitments, and outstanding deliverables.

- Escalate blockers when necessary rather than allowing projects to stall.

- Push for clear answers, realistic timelines, and completed work.

- Maintain a record of follow-ups and next steps so nothing falls through the cracks.



**We need someone who is persistent without being rude, assertive without being unprofessional, and comfortable reminding people repeatedly when necessary.**



If you are uncomfortable chasing people, holding others accountable, or having difficult conversations, this position is not for you.



### 3. Living in Slack and Managing Daily Operations



We need someone who is highly responsive and comfortable working in a communication-driven environment.



- Stay actively engaged in Slack during agreed-upon working hours.

- Monitor relevant conversations, respond to messages, and follow up on open items.

- Keep projects moving through regular communication with the production team.

- Make sure important decisions, requests, and changes are documented.

- Turn conversations into actionable tasks with clear owners and deadlines.

- Identify unanswered questions, stalled tasks, and communication gaps.

- Ensure the owner does not have to repeatedly ask for updates on routine work.



We are looking for someone who treats Slack as a core working environment—not someone who checks messages occasionally and disappears for hours during agreed working hours.



### 4. Coordinating Developers, Designers, and Marketers



- Translate client requests into clear instructions for the appropriate team member.

- Coordinate website development, design, revisions, and digital marketing tasks.

- Make sure team members understand the expected outcome, deadline, and requirements.

- Follow up on progress and identify delays early.

- Review completed work against the original request before presenting it to the client.

- Send incomplete or incorrect work back for correction.

- Coordinate revisions until the client’s requirements have been properly addressed.

- Keep multiple projects organized and ensure the right people are working on the right priorities.



You do not need to be an expert developer or designer. However, you must understand enough about these fields to communicate intelligently, ask the right questions, recognize obvious issues, and coordinate work effectively.



### 5. Project Management and Organization



- Manage multiple client accounts and projects simultaneously.

- Maintain clear task lists, deadlines, project statuses, and next steps.

- Use project management software to track work and hold people accountable.

- Anticipate upcoming deadlines and follow up before problems arise.

- Keep records of client feedback, revisions, approvals, and outstanding items.

- Prioritize urgent work while ensuring other projects continue moving.

- Provide clear status updates and escalate problems that require a decision.



The goal is simple: **you should know what is happening across your projects without having to be reminded to check.**



### 6. Quality Control and Problem Solving



- Check deliverables before they are sent to clients.

- Verify that completed work matches the client's instructions.

- Identify missing details, errors, and unfinished revisions.

- Ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.

- Work with the production team to resolve issues.

- Take responsibility for coordinating solutions instead of simply forwarding problems to the owner.



## Required Skills and Experience



### Essential Requirements



- Experience in account management, project management, client success, agency operations, or a similar role.

- Experience coordinating multiple people and projects.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong professional communication and follow-up skills.

- Confidence dealing with difficult clients, unresponsive team members, and competing priorities.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to take ownership and work independently.

- Comfortable communicating throughout the workday using Slack and other online tools.

- Reliable availability during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



### Technical and Industry Knowledge



You should have a working understanding of at least some of the following:



- Website development and how web projects move from requirements to delivery.

- Website design, mockups, revisions, and client approvals.

- Digital marketing services and campaign workflows.

- WordPress and website content updates.

- Project management tools such as ClickUp or 
.

- Slack, Google Workspace, and other online collaboration tools.



You do not need to perform the developers' or designers' technical work yourself. You do need enough familiarity to understand their progress, coordinate their tasks, and communicate with clients intelligently.



## The Type of Person We Want



The right person is:



- **Proactive:** You identify what needs to happen and act without waiting to be told.

- **Persistent:** You follow up repeatedly until you get answers and results.

- **Assertive:** You are comfortable holding people accountable professionally.

- **Highly responsive:** You communicate consistently during working hours.

- **Organized:** You keep track of multiple projects without losing details.

- **Resourceful:** You investigate problems and propose solutions before escalating.

- **Accountable:** You take ownership instead of blaming others.

- **Client-focused:** You can handle demanding clients without becoming defensive or losing professionalism.

- **Technically curious:** You understand the basics of web development, design, and marketing and are willing to learn more.

- **Independent:** You do not need the owner to chase you for updates or remind you to follow up with everyone else.



We value people who are comfortable being persistent and asking for updates multiple times when needed. We do not want someone who avoids uncomfortable conversations, accepts vague answers, or lets tasks sit unfinished.



## What This Position Is NOT



This is not a passive data-entry job.



It is not a role where you simply forward messages between clients and developers.



It is not a position for someone who waits for the owner to identify every problem and provide every next step.



We need a manager who actively drives execution, communicates consistently, and takes responsibility for getting projects across the finish line.



## Schedule and Work Commitments



- Monday–Friday, during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Consistent availability and responsiveness are essential.

- During agreed working hours, this role must be your priority, and you must not perform other jobs or freelance client work.

- You must disclose existing employment, freelance clients, and other work commitments.

- You must be able to manage your workload reliably without repeatedly disappearing, missing messages, or leaving tasks unattended.



## Compensation



Our budget is **$500–$700 USD per month**, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



In your application, you must state the specific monthly amount you expect within this range and explain why your skills and experience justify that amount.



We are looking for value, ownership, strong communication, and reliable execution—not simply the lowest-cost applicant.



## Application Process



To be considered, you must complete our application form.



The form asks about your agency experience, your ability to coordinate developers and designers, how you handle difficult client situations, your project management methods, your technical familiarity, your availability, and your salary expectations.



Please provide specific examples. Generic answers such as “I am hardworking,” “I am organized,” or “I am a good communicator” are not enough. We want to understand what you have actually done and how you handle real situations.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment and attend a brief interview.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Are you the type of salesperson who loves closing deals, hates leaving money on the table, and knows how to turn a “let me think about it” into a booked job? We want you on our team!



JT is looking for a driven, confident, and highly organized Inside Sales Representative who knows how to sell over the phone. We're not looking for someone who simply answers inquiries and sends quotes. We need someone who takes ownership of every lead, follows up consistently, handles objections, and turns potential customers into paying customers.



If you enjoy talking to people, chasing opportunities, hitting targets, and seeing your hard work translate into results, this could be the perfect role for you.



What You'll Be Doing

Close sales over the phone. Turn inbound inquiries into booked jobs by building rapport, asking the right questions, presenting solutions, and confidently asking for the sale.

Move fast on new leads. Contact new inquiries within 5 minutes whenever possible. Speed matters, and we don't want good leads going cold.

Follow up like a pro. Call, text, and reconnect with customers who haven't booked yet. One call is rarely enough, and you'll know when to keep the conversation going.

Turn estimates into sales. Follow up on open quotes, address concerns, overcome price objections, and help customers make a decision.

Manage a busy pipeline. Keep track of new leads, callbacks, text conversations, pending estimates, and scheduled jobs without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Keep the CRM updated. Record accurate notes, track every conversation, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.

Coordinate with the team. Help customers with scheduling, answer questions, and ensure a smooth experience from the first call to the booked job.

Hit your numbers. Work toward daily sales goals, strong conversion rates, and consistent performance.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a salesperson first, not just a customer service representative.



You might be a great fit if you:

Have 2–5+ years of experience in inside sales, telesales, appointment setting, or phone-based sales.

Are comfortable spending most of your workday making and receiving calls.

Know how to handle objections, discuss pricing, and confidently ask customers to buy.

Don't give up after one unanswered call or one “not right now.”

Can manage multiple conversations and tasks without losing track of important details.

Are comfortable using CRMs, phone systems, text messaging platforms, and scheduling tools.

Communicate in clear, natural, professional English.

Take ownership of your results and don't need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

Are competitive, coachable, organized, and motivated by hitting targets.

Can take feedback, participate in call reviews, and work on improving your sales skills.

Experience in home services is a plus, but it's not required. If you've sold HVAC services, roofing, plumbing, cleaning services, insurance, automotive services, memberships, or other consumer services over the phone, we'd love to hear from you.



We can teach you our services and systems. What we can't teach as easily is the drive to pick up the phone, follow up, and close the deal.



What Success Looks Like

We want someone who takes every lead seriously and understands that every missed follow-up could mean a missed sale.



Here are the results we're working toward:



New leads contacted in under 5 minutes whenever possible.

A target booking/close rate of 50% or higher.

Consistent follow-up on every open estimate and sales opportunity.

A meaningful contribution toward JT's daily sales goal of $20,000+.

Accurate CRM records and a pipeline where no lead gets forgotten.

These are performance targets, not guarantees. Your ability to consistently execute, learn, and improve will matter.



What This Job Is NOT

Let's be clear about a few things.



This is not a passive customer service role where you answer questions and wait for the next call.

This is not a job where you send a quote and hope the customer gets back to you.

This is not a fit for someone who dislikes making outbound calls or following up multiple times.

This is not a role for someone who needs constant supervision to stay productive.

Some customers will say no. Some won't answer. Some will push back on price. That's part of sales. We need someone who stays professional, keeps moving, and knows how to create opportunities instead of waiting for them.



Why Join JT?

Work remotely from home.

Be part of a team that values initiative, accountability, and results.

Develop your phone sales, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Have clear performance goals so you know what success looks like.

Get the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's growth.

title: Ecommerce Bookkeeper
description:
We need a remote, part-time bookkeeper who keeps the books for our small ecommerce companies and a rental property current every week and sends the owner a weekly spending report. Our existing senior bookkeeper keeps ownership of month-end close, so your job is to hand over each month's accounts fully coded and reconciled, so that close is a quick review rather than a catch-up.



What you will do

Every week, for each company:

Bank and card feeds. Categorize and match every bank, credit card, PayPal and Wise transaction in QuickBooks, with no items left in the "for review" queue at week end.

Import Amazon settlements. Record each Amazon settlement (roughly every two weeks) so that it ties to the deposit.

Reconcile. Reconcile bank and card accounts at least weekly so balances match statements.



Each Monday, you will send the owner a spending report for the previous Monday to Sunday. It will cover each company separately. Also included will be a cash position summary and open items (transactions you could not categorize and receipts still missing).



We will agree the template in your first week We will use a QuickBooks report so it can be quickly refreshed and output.



What you need

• 2 years of bookkeeping for US small businesses in QuickBooks Online

• Good Excel or Google Sheets skills for reconciliations and the weekly report

• Clear written English and the habit of flagging problems early rather than guessing

• Reliable internet



Nice to have

• Experience with inventory businesses, purchase orders and landed cost

• Rental property bookkeeping, including mortgage principal, interest and escrow splits



How to apply

Send a short note covering your QuickBooks Online and Amazon experience, the number of client files you handle now, your hourly or monthly rate, and your available hours. We plan to start with a paid trial which will allow us to gauge how much time this will take each week.
