title: SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
*************Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.***************



************* This is an inhouse position only************** 



Kitchen & Bath Authority has been serving the home improvement industry for over 23 years. As we continue to grow our digital presence, we are looking for a results-driven SEO Specialist / SEO Manager with hands-on experience in modern search, backlink acquisition, content strategy, and AI-driven optimization.



This is a full-time position with some scheduling flexibility. Core availability and reliable communication are expected during agreed-upon working hours, but we are open to accommodating your time zone on certain days of the week.



This role is ideal for someone who can both execute SEO initiatives independently and take ownership of projects, priorities, and potentially other team members or external partners as our digital team continues to grow.



What You'll Do



• Manage and improve on-page SEO across product, category, and content pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimization



• Develop and execute backlink acquisition strategies through outreach, editorial placements, guest posting, partnerships, and digital PR



• Optimize content and site structure for emerging AI-powered search experiences, including AI Overviews (AIO), generative search surfaces, and image/search optimization opportunities



• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis across our kitchen, bath, lighting, and home improvement product categories



• Plan, assign, review, and optimize SEO-focused blog and landing-page content; AI writing tools are welcome, but strong human editing, fact-checking, and optimization are required



• Identify technical SEO issues and work with developers or internal team members to prioritize and implement improvements



• Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, backlink growth, and other key SEO KPIs using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and related tools



• Prepare clear monthly performance reports and translate SEO data into actionable recommendations



• Take ownership of SEO priorities, timelines, and deliverables while helping coordinate writers, developers, freelancers, agencies, or other digital team members when necessary



• Help establish SEO processes, documentation, quality standards, and best practices as the department grows



Requirements



• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in e-commerce



• Demonstrated ability to manage SEO projects from strategy through execution and reporting



• Some managerial, team-lead, project-management, or vendor-management experience preferred



• Must submit at least 2 case studies or documented examples of past SEO success showing where you started, what actions you took, and the measurable results



• Proven backlink acquisition experience with a clear and repeatable outreach process



• Working knowledge of AI-powered search optimization, structured data, and emerging search experiences



• Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs and/or SEMrush, and technical SEO auditing tools



• Strong understanding of on-page SEO, internal linking, keyword strategy, content optimization, and technical SEO fundamentals



• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, meet deadlines, and clearly communicate results and recommendations



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Nice to Have



• Experience in home improvement, kitchen and bath, lighting, furniture, or home décor e-commerce



• Experience managing writers, SEO contractors, outreach specialists, or other digital marketing team members



• Basic HTML/CSS knowledge



• Experience with large e-commerce catalogs and product/category-page optimization



Compensation & Benefits



• Full-time position



• Paid Time Off (PTO)



• Paid U.S. holidays



• Scheduling flexibility with agreed-upon core availability



• Potential flexibility to accommodate your local time zone on certain days of the week



• Opportunity to take on greater ownership and managerial responsibility as the digital team grows



To Apply



Please send:



• Your resume



• At least 2 SEO case studies or documented examples of measurable SEO results



• A brief introduction video telling us about yourself, your SEO experience, and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role



Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.



Bonus points if you also include a Loom walkthrough of a site audit, SEO project, backlink campaign, or ranking win. Candidates who provide a strong walkthrough will receive priority consideration.



We are looking for someone who can do more than follow an SEO checklist. We want someone who can identify opportunities, take ownership, execute effectively, measure results, and help lead our SEO efforts as we continue to grow.

title: Sales Representative, US Website Company: $800 Base Plus Uncapped Commission
description:
Mirin is a small website company in East Lyme, Connecticut. We build a better homepage for local businesses, therapists first, from their own words and photos, before we ever contact them. Then we show it to the owner. They can put it online free, or on their own domain for $99 a month.



You will be the person who turns those homepages into customers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Call business owners who opened the homepage we made for them, and the ones we can only reach by phone.

• Read and approve the first
 our system drafts for each business before it goes out under your name.

• Answer owners who write back, and help them keep their homepage.

• Work entirely inside our CRM. You call from your browser with a headset, and every call and
 is logged for you.



You never write a pitch from scratch, and you never call a random list. Every business you contact already has a homepage made for it.



WHAT YOU EARN

• $800 a month base, paid twice a month by Payoneer or Wise.

• Commission on every sale, more per sale as your month goes, with no cap:

   1st to 10th sale in a month: $50 for each Pro customer, $100 for each Business customer

   11th to 20th: $99 and $199

   21st to 30th: $149 and $299

   31st and on: $198 and $398

• 10 Pro sales in a month pay $500 in commission on top of your base. 20 pay $1,490. 30 pay $2,980. 40 pay $4,960.

• A sale counts when the customer pays their second monthly invoice, so your first month is base pay.

• We start with a paid two week trial.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern time. That is a night shift in the Philippines (10 PM to 6 AM until March).



WHAT YOU NEED

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent, and confidence on the phone with US small business owners.

• At least one year of outbound phone sales, appointment setting or closing for US clients.

• A reliable computer with Chrome, a stable internet connection with a backup, and a quiet room.

• A headset with a microphone. This is required for every call.

• A Google account to sign in with.

• You are comfortable with your own side of calls being recorded and transcribed for coaching. This is in the contract.



NICE TO HAVE

• You have sold websites, marketing services or software to small businesses.

• You have worked with therapists, clinics or other healthcare practices.

• You have used a CRM every day.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application subject with "Mirin East Lyme" so we know you read this post. Then include:



1. A voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds (a Vocaroo or Google Drive link). First, read this as if you were on a real call:



"Hi Dr. Benning, it's [your name] with Mirin, a small website company in East Lyme, Connecticut. I sent you a homepage we made for Mystic River Psychology on Tuesday. Did you have a chance to look?"



Then, in your own words, answer the owner who asks: "How much is it?" The facts: the homepage costs nothing to look at. It can go online free at a Mirin address, or on their own domain for $99 a month.



2. In three sentences, your best month in sales: what you sold, how many, and how you were paid.



3. When you could start.



Applications without the recording are not reviewed.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor & Content Producer

Contract | Remote | Part-Time to Full-Time Potential

Kirsi Hall | Results Loop | 



About This Role



I'm Kirsi Hall — a leadership coach, trainer, and author helping leaders and organizations understand that feelings drive performance. My work — the Results Loop — reaches leaders across scaling tech companies through training, coaching, keynotes, and now a growing content platform.



I have 30+ raw Zoom recordings ready to transform into polished, high-impact content. I need a creative, technically savvy Video Editor and Content Producer to take my footage and turn it into something spectacular — content that matches the quality and warmth of my brand and reaches leaders wherever they are.



This is a contract role to start, with strong potential to become ongoing as we work through a growing library of videos together.



What You'll Do



You'll own the full production pipeline, from raw recording to published content:

-Edit Zoom recordings into polished long-form training videos for online course platforms

-Create short-form content (60–90 second clips) optimized for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn

-Add motion graphics, text overlays, and branded visuals that align with the Kirsi Hall / Results Loop brand (teal, orange, clean and modern)

-Design custom thumbnails for YouTube and other platforms

-Write or refine captions, titles, and video descriptions for each platform

-Format and optimize content for each platform's specs and best practices

-Use AI-powered editing and production tools (e.g., Descript, Opus Clip, CapCut, or similar) to enhance efficiency and quality

-Suggest creative ideas for how to make the content more engaging, visual, and impactful



About You

You're a skilled video editor who also thinks like a producer. You don't just cut footage — you shape stories. You're comfortable with:

-Professional video editing (whatever software you're most proficient in — Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.)

-Motion graphics and text animation

-Thumbnail creation and basic graphic design

-AI and digital production tools — you're the tech-savvy person in the room

-Working independently with clear brand guidelines and minimal hand-holding

-Communicating clearly and reliably in a remote, async environment



Bonus if you have experience with:

-Editing leadership, coaching, or training content

-Creating content for Substack, Medium, or professional learning platforms

-Captions and accessibility formatting

-Managing content calendars or scheduling posts



The Work

-Volume: 30+ Zoom recordings to start, with ongoing work as new content is created

-Deliverables: Long-form training videos (course-ready), short-form clips (YouTube Shorts / LinkedIn), thumbnails, captions, and platform-ready files

-Brand: Kirsi Hall / Results Loop — teal and orange palette, clean modern aesthetic, warm and authoritative tone. Brand assets will be provided.

-Timeline: Flexible — we'll agree on turnaround times that work for both of us

-Communication: Async-friendly, with regular check-ins as needed



Compensation

-Mid-range, competitive pay for this type of work. Rate will be discussed based on your experience and the scope of each project. This is a contract engagement with potential for ongoing work.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

-Sample videos you have edited — 2 to 3 examples of your best work (links or files)

-Your YouTube channel or portfolio link if you have one

-A short video introduction of yourself (optional but encouraged — 1 to 2 minutes, casual is fine)

-A brief note about your experience with AI and digital production tools

-I'm looking for someone who is genuinely excited about this kind of work and brings creative energy to the role. If that's you, I'd love to hear from you.



Kirsi Hall  |  Empowering Human Connection  |

title: home health administrative asistant
description:
The Home Health Administrative Assistant provides administrative and operational support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the home health agency. This position assists with patient intake, referral processing, medical record management, scheduling, billing preparation, payroll documentation, and communication with patients, physicians, caregivers, and clinical staff.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and familiar with home health operations, Medicare documentation requirements, and electronic medical record (EMR) systems.









Essential Duties and Responsibilities



1. Patient Intake and Referral Coordination



Receive, process, and track incoming patient referrals from hospitals, physicians, rehabilitation facilities, and other referral sources.



Collect and verify required patient demographic information, insurance details, physician information, and referral documentation.



Assist with obtaining hospital discharge summaries, medication lists, orders, and other supporting records.



Coordinate with the clinical team to facilitate timely patient admissions.



Maintain accurate referral and admission tracking logs.



Communicate with patients and caregivers regarding scheduling and administrative requirements.



2. Medical Records and Documentation



Maintain complete, accurate, and organized electronic and paper patient records, as applicable.



Monitor documentation for missing signatures, incomplete forms, outstanding physician orders, and other administrative deficiencies.



Follow up with nurses, therapists, physicians, and other authorized personnel regarding outstanding documentation.



Track required admission, recertification, reassessment, discharge, and other clinical documentation deadlines.



Assist with organizing documentation for internal audits, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys.



Protect patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and agency privacy policies.



3. Scheduling and Staff Coordination



Assist with scheduling skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and other authorized home health visits.



Communicate scheduling changes and patient care coordination needs to the appropriate clinical personnel.



Track missed visits, rescheduled visits, and outstanding visit documentation.



Maintain staff contact lists, schedules, and administrative records.



Escalate urgent scheduling issues and patient-related concerns to the appropriate clinical supervisor.



4. Billing and Payroll Support



Review visit documentation for administrative completeness before submitting records for billing review.



Identify missing or incomplete visit notes and communicate correction requirements to the responsible clinician.



Maintain a tracking log of visits pending documentation, billing submission, or correction.



Assist with preparing completed visit records for billing personnel or the designated billing vendor.



Verify submitted visit records against approved staff schedules and visit logs for payroll processing.



Identify discrepancies in visit dates, visit durations, documentation, or approved pay records and report them to management.



Meet established billing and payroll deadlines.



Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and payroll information.



5. Physician Orders and Follow-Up



Track outstanding physician orders, certifications, recertifications, and required signatures.



Follow up with physician offices regarding pending documentation.



Maintain a log of orders sent, received, and awaiting completion.



Route clinical questions, changes in patient condition, and medical concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician.



Do not independently provide clinical advice, alter medical orders, or make clinical decisions.



6. Compliance and Quality Assurance Support



Assist with maintaining administrative records required for Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and applicable state requirements.



Support preparation for internal audits, accreditation reviews, and regulatory surveys.



Monitor administrative checklists for incomplete records and overdue documentation.



Follow agency policies for record retention, privacy, security, and document handling.



Report suspected compliance issues, documentation irregularities, or privacy incidents to the Administrator.



Complete assigned compliance training and maintain required confidentiality standards.



7. Communication and General Office Administration



Answer telephone calls, respond to routine inquiries, and direct calls to the appropriate department.



Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence,
s, faxes, and electronic documents.



Maintain office supplies, administrative forms, filing systems, and staff records.



Assist with preparing reports, spreadsheets, meeting materials, and operational tracking logs.



Provide professional customer service to patients, families, referral partners, physicians, and employees.



Perform other administrative duties as assigned.



Qualifications and Requirements



High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or relevant administrative training preferred.



One to two years of healthcare administrative experience preferred.

title: Social Media Growth Marketer for Organic Growth Audit and Strategy
description:
**Job type:** Project-based, with potential for ongoing consulting  

**Pay:** Please include your rate or project fee in your application



We’re looking for an experienced social media growth marketer to audit our channels and help us build an organic audience from scratch.



We want someone who understands how to grow accounts through strong content, clear positioning, and a thoughtful platform-specific strategy. We’re looking for practical advice our team can actually put into action.



You’ll review our current presence and help us figure out what’s working, what’s holding us back, and what we should change to reach more of the right people.



## Platforms



- TikTok

- Instagram, especially Reels

- YouTube Shorts

- X

- Reddit



We understand that each platform works differently. We’re looking for someone who can explain where we should focus, how our approach should change by platform, and which opportunities are worth prioritizing.



## What you’ll do



- Audit our existing social media accounts, content, profiles, and analytics

- Review our positioning, messaging, content formats, hooks, captions, and calls to action

- Identify missed opportunities and common issues that may be limiting reach or engagement

- Research relevant creators, competitors, and communities for ideas we can learn from

- Recommend a practical organic growth strategy for each platform

- Suggest content themes, formats, and post ideas that fit our audience and goals

- Advise on posting frequency, content distribution, engagement, and community building

- Recommend the metrics we should track and how to use them to improve

- Help us prioritize what to fix first and what to test over time



For Reddit specifically, we’d like guidance on participating in relevant communities in a way that respects their rules and contributes to conversations.



## What we’re looking for



- Proven experience growing organic social media accounts, ideally from a small or new starting point

- Strong understanding of short-form video and how to hold attention

- Experience developing content strategies for multiple platforms

- Ability to look at analytics and turn findings into clear recommendations

- Strong written English and communication skills

- Someone who can explain *why* they recommend a change, not just list generic best practices



Experience with gaming, entertainment, or indie games is a plus, but it’s not required.



## Expected deliverables



At the end of the project, we’d like:



1. A written audit of each channel, including the biggest strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities

2. A prioritized action plan showing what we should address first

3. Platform-specific recommendations for content, profiles, posting, and engagement

4. A list of content ideas and tests our team can use to get started

5. A 30-day plan with suggested actions and metrics to track

6. A call to walk us through your findings and answer questions



We’re open to your suggestions on the best way to structure the project. If we work well together, there may be an opportunity for ongoing consulting.



## How to apply



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and an overview of your experience with organic social media growth

2. Links to accounts you’ve helped grow, along with a short explanation of your role and the results

3. An example of an account you helped grow from a small starting point, if available

4. Which of the five platforms you know best and which you have less experience with

5. How you’d approach an audit for a brand starting with a small audience

6. Your project fee or hourly rate, estimated turnaround time, and availability



Please be specific about the work you personally did on the accounts you share. We’re interested in your thinking and experience, so there’s no need for a long, generic cover letter.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Customer Service - PayPal & Shopify disputes (German General Dropshipping Store)
description:
We run a German Shopify store: general dropshipping, DHL/DPD shipping, PayPal and Shopify Payments (Klarna). We need one Customer Service person for the German inbox, working in one focused round per day.



HOW THE DAY WORKS

- You handle every
 from the previous day in one round. You do not sit in the inbox all day.

WHAT WE EXPECT

- Speed: 30 to 50 customer responses per hour with our templates, without losing quality.

- Completeness: every
 from the previous day is answered. Nothing is left older than one day.

- Discipline: every case is logged in our sheet with the proof and the refund amount. No log, no payment.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

- English for daily reporting in Slack.

- Shopify orders and refunds, PayPal Resolution Center, Gmail.

- You follow a written SOP exactly. 



TRIAL AND PAY

- 6 working days paid trial: paid at the end of that week.

Also tell us which hours you can work, in Central European Time. Applications without the German answers are not reviewed.

description:

You open YouTube Studio before you open your inbox.

You follow algorithm changes because they change how you edit.

You want to grow your craft on channels that matter.

This is not for you if you want to polish for weeks, wait for perfect direction, or avoid feedback on your numbers.

Full-time, fully remote work, open worldwide, with flexible hours.

A growth path inside the video team as you prove results.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Edit long-form YouTube videos (8-20 min) and Shorts built for retention.

Optimize pacing, visuals, subtitles and sound design.

, and store files in Google Drive.

REQUIREMENTS

Your edits run on a consistent weekly publishing schedule for your channels [confirm].

Average view duration on your videos beats each channel's starting baseline.

Every long-form video you edit ships with Shorts cut from it.

You deliver a written retention review for each video you edit, with changes for the next one.

Revision rounds drop as you learn each client's brand and style.

Fully remote, open worldwide.

Flexible hours, with enough overlap with JSM's core hours 6:00 AM-2:00 PM EST

Deadlines are firm. Channels publish on schedule, so your edits do too.

Full-Time

Competitive salary, paid monthly.
USD

Results over hours: output counts, not time online.

title: Sales & Lead Qualification Specialist – Dental Implant Courses & Patient Leads (Remote, US Hours, Base + Commission)
description:
ABOUT US

Ascendia Group is an AI-powered marketing and growth agency for dental and healthcare practices in the US and Canada. We generate leads for two things: dental implant continuing-education courses for dentists, and implant treatment at dental clinics. We need someone who reaches those leads fast, answers their questions, and gets them registered or booked.



THE ROLE

Most of our leads are warm and close to a decision. Your job is to reach them fast, answer their final questions confidently and accurately, and get them registered or booked, without pressure or hard selling.



About half your time goes to dentists interested in our implant courses, working alongside our enrollment managers. The other half goes to patients interested in dental implants, whom you book into consultations at our client clinics. You own the pipeline, the follow-up, and your numbers.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Contact new leads within minutes during your shift by phone, SMS, and

- Answer questions confidently about our implant courses (curriculum, format, CE credits, dates, pricing, financing) and implant treatment basics for patients

- Get course leads registered, and bring in our enrollment managers when needed

- Book patient leads into consultations at client clinics

- Follow up on no-shows, und
 leads, and past registrants until there's a clear yes or no

- Keep every lead, note, and task current in GoHighLevel (CRM) and ClickUp, every day

- Report your numbers weekly: speed-to-lead, contact rate, registrations, consults booked, and shows

- Spot what's breaking in the process (lead quality, scripts, handoffs) and propose fixes

- Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to prep for calls, summarize conversations, draft follow-ups, and analyze your performance



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, remote, aligned to US Eastern / Central hours

- Weekend shifts are part of the regular schedule (for example Tue–Sat or Wed–Sun), since many leads come in evenings and weekends

- Extra flexibility needed during webinars, course launches, and conferences



PAY

- $400/month base

- $50–$200 per course registration you support, depending on course price

- $10 per patient consultation that shows

- Monthly bonus for hitting registration targets

- Top performers earn several times the base. This role is built for someone driven by results.



MUST-HAVES

- 2+ years in inside sales, lead qualification, SDR, or appointment setting, with numbers to prove it

- Excellent spoken and written English, confident on the phone with US doctors and patients

- Ability to learn detailed course information (curriculum, CE credits, schedules, pricing, financing, policies) and explain it clearly and accurately

- Highly organized. You never lose a lead or miss a follow-up.

- Hands-on ClickUp experience

- Daily use of AI tools to work faster and track your performance

- Proactive and self-managing, comfortable improving processes with minimal supervision

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset, and backup power and internet



STRONG PLUSES

- Experience selling to dentists, doctors, or healthcare professionals

- Dental, implant, or healthcare background

- Experience with high-ticket education, coaching, or course sales

- GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll report to our Account Manager & Client Operations Lead and our President, and work closely with our course enrollment managers.



FIRST 90 DAYS

- Every new lead contacted within the target window during your shift

Send the following to 
 with the subject line "Sales & Lead Qualification Specialist – [Your Name]":

Suggest improvements where you spot something inefficient



What We’re Looking For

Experience in an executive assistant, admin, or coordination role within a company is required

Understanding of basic bookkeeping and how expenses map to a chart of accounts is required

Experience supporting U.S.-based clients or teams is required

Fluent written and spoken English with confident client and vendor communication

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage several things at once

Able to work independently and manage your own day without being chased

Experience coordinating travel or calendars for senior leadership is preferred

Experience with vendor coordination, purchase orders, or order tracking is preferred

CRM and sales administration experience is preferred

Prior experience at an interior design or architecture firm is preferred



What We Offer

Full-time, long-term role

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Paid U.S. holiday leaves

Medical stipend after 3 months

Opportunity to grow into expanded responsibility over time

Clear opportunities for growth and professional development

Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment

title: Executive Search Recruiter & Research Analyst
description:
About Crimson Jay Executive Search Partners



Crimson Jay Executive Search Partners is a retained executive search firm that partners with founder-led and investor-backed companies to recruit transformational financial and operational leaders. We specialize in placing CFOs, COOs, and senior executives who drive scalable growth, build infrastructure, and position businesses for successful exits.



Our clients are typically high-growth companies ranging from $1M to $200M in revenue across B2B services, SaaS, manufacturing, and financial services. Our work is highly strategic, often tied directly to value creation initiatives and investment outcomes.



We operate with a structured, outcome-driven process focused on deep upfront alignment, disciplined candidate evaluation, and high-quality execution. This is not high-volume recruiting, this is precision search.



Role Overview



This role is not just research and coordination, it is a critical front-end gatekeeper of candidate quality.



The Executive Search Research Analyst & Candidate Screening Associate will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and qualifying executive talent before candidates ever reach the Founder. This includes assessing whether candidates are true “drivers” of scale versus those who have operated within already successful environments.



You will play a central role in shaping candidate pipelines, improving signal-to-noise ratio, and ensuring that only high-caliber, well-aligned candidates move forward in the process.



This is a high-responsibility role with direct impact on search outcomes.



Key Responsibilities



Candidate Sourcing & Market Research



• Build highly targeted candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and market mapping

• Develop company target lists, org charts, and competitive landscapes aligned to each search

• Track executive movement, private equity activity, and industry trends to identify relevant talent

• Continuously refine sourcing strategies to improve candidate quality, not just volume



Candidate Screening & Qualification (Core Focus)



• Conduct initial candidate screening calls to assess:

• Ability to drive scalability versus operate within existing success

• Experience building infrastructure, KPIs, and operating cadence

• Alignment with investor-backed environments and value creation goals

• Career trajectory and job transition patterns over the past 10–15 years



• Evaluate candidates against defined measurable outcomes for each role



• Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks early in the process



• Prepare concise, high-signal candidate summaries with clear recommendations



• Act as a quality filter to ensure only strong, well-vetted candidates move forward



Search Execution Support



• Maintain and manage candidate pipelines within Loxo ATS with precision and consistency

• Assist in building candidate scorecards, interview materials, and client deliverables

• Coordinate interviews and ensure a smooth, professional candidate experience

• Support reference check coordination and candidate communication throughout the process



Administrative & Operational Support



• Provide light executive support including scheduling and coordination

• Format and prepare client-facing documents such as job profiles and candidate presentations

• Track search progress, timelines, and deliverables across active engagements

• Help refine internal workflows, templates, and SOPs to improve efficiency and scalability



Qualifications



• 2–5 years of experience in executive search, recruiting, or research preferred

• Strong interviewing instincts and ability to assess talent beyond resumes

• High attention to detail and ability to synthesize information quickly

• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search required

• Familiarity with ATS systems such as Loxo preferred

• Strong written communication skills, especially in summarizing candidates clearly and concisely

• Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment



What Success Looks Like in This Role



• You consistently surface high-quality candidates who align with the role’s true needs

• You reduce time spent on unqualified or misaligned candidates

• Your screening identifies “drivers” of scale, not “riders” of 
ntum

• Your candidate summaries are clear, accurate, and decision-ready

• You improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the overall search process



Who You Are



• A sharp evaluator of talent who can read between the lines

• Naturally curious, with a strong instinct to probe deeper

• Highly accountable and comfortable operating with autonomy

• Structured, detail-oriented, and process-driven

• Comfortable working behind the scenes but motivated by impact



Why Join Crimson Jay



You will work directly with the Founder on high-impact executive searches tied to real business outcomes, including growth, transformation, and exit readiness.



This is an opportunity to learn how elite executive search is actually done, with a focus on judgment, quality, and precision, not volume.



You will gain exposure to private equity-backed companies, founder-led businesses, and top-tier operators, while building a highly transferable skill set in talent evaluation, business strategy, and executive hiring.

description:

 newsletters. Major publishers place our ad tag in their newsletters, and we serve native image ads for direct-response offers (health, home, finance, consumer products) that we have exclusive access to. We are a small, fast-moving team and we are growing quickly.



The role



A major lever on our revenue is how fast we test new ad creative. The same product can earn $1 or $10 per thousand impressions depending on the image. Right now we are doing that testing by hand. We want you to own it.



You will:



Review daily performance per ad creative across our publishers and d
 what to scale, what to cut and what to test next



Come up with new image and headline concepts for each offer and brief our designers and copywriters on them



Set up and manage split tests in our Experiments tool (offer splits, then creative splits within each offer)



Read early funnel signals (clicks, add-to-cart, checkout starts) rather than waiting on conversions alone



Keep a running log of what wins and why, so our learnings compound across offers and publishers



Work directly with the founders and our dev team on how we automate parts of this over time



Who we are looking for:



-At least 3 years running native advertising campaigns (Taboola, Outbrain, MGID, Revcontent, newsletter ads or similar). 




 or Google only is not the same thing. You need to understand how native ads work: the image stops the scroll, the headline earns the click, the landing page does the selling.



-A real eye for creative. You can look at ten image variants and have a strong, defensible opinion on which three to test first.



-Comfortable with numbers. eCPM, RPM, CTR, CVR and EPC should be second nature, and you should be able to spot when a “winner” is just one lucky conversion.



-Direct-response or affiliate background is a big plus (health, supplements, home products, finance offers)



-Organized and self-directed. You will have a lot of autonomy and we expect you to run with it.



-Strong written English. You will be briefing designers and reporting to founders every day.



-Available for at least 3 to 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time



Nice to have



-Experience with Canva or briefing designers on ad image concepts



-Experience with
 newsletter advertising specifically (LiveIntent, Paved, Beehiiv ads, etc.)



-Familiarity with affiliate tracking platforms like Everflow



How to apply



To make sure you’ve read this far, start your application with the word “STEAK”. Then answer these two questions:



1. Describe a native ad campaign you ran where changing the creative made a big difference in results. What did you change, what happened to the numbers, and how did you know it was real and not noise?



2. Pick any direct-response product you like (a supplement, a kitchen pan, a knee brace, whatever). List five image concepts you would test for it as a native ad and one sentence on why each one might win.



Applications that skip the questions won’t be reviewed.

title: Escalation Engineer
description:
Escalation Engineer

Job Advert

Full-Time Remote-First

Salary: $10 - $13 (Depends on experience)



The challenge

Every managed service provider has the same quiet problem. The clever engineer becomes the person everything gets thrown at, spends their week doing work three other people could have done, and never gets the two uninterrupted hours it would take to work out why the same fault keeps coming back. So, it keeps coming back. For years. We have built this seat specifically to stop that happening here.

It is protected. As our band structure is implemented, band technicians will not escalate directly to you. Escalations will follow a defined approval path through the Project / Account Manager, ensuring routine issues remain with the appropriate technicians while genuinely complex problems reach you. Your manager's job description explicitly includes defending your thinking time. And you are measured on repeat i
 eliminated, not tickets closed, which is a deliberate choice about what we want you to optimize for.



The role

You are the technical escalation point for the company. When the support team has exhausted the normal troubleshooting path, the problem comes to you. As our technician band structure is introduced, this role will sit above those bands as the technical escalation point for issues they cannot resolve. The immediate priority is restoring service safely, especially when a healthcare facility has a critical system unavailable, and residents or staff are depending on it. You need to be comfortable troubleshooting under pressure, including with a client on the phone, without losing your ability to think clearly. But getting things working again is only the beginning.

Once the issue is stabilized, you determine why it happened. You hypothesize, isolate, gather evidence, test, and prove the root cause rather than settling for a plausible explanation. From there, you determine whether the same condition exists elsewhere, permanently correct it, improve the documentation, or work with our Cloud Automation Engineers where automation can eliminate the problem altogether. Firefight → Root Cause → Pattern → Permanent Fix. You will also own complex networking work, from troubleshooting existing environments to designing, building, provisioning, configuring, deploying, validating, and documenting networks for new clients, new locations, and network refreshes.

You will also help raise the technical capability of the support team. Through monthly knowledge sessions, you will walk technicians through difficult issues, your troubleshooting approach, what the evidence showed, and how similar problems should be handled in the future. As the band structure is introduced, that knowledge transfer will help raise the technical ceiling within each band. Some issues will inevitably reach you that should have been resolved before escalation. Your job is to identify what was missed, return the escalation when appropriate, and help technicians build the knowledge needed, so the same type of issue does not need to reach you again.

That keeps bands in the vision but makes it honest that you're transitioning toward that structure rather than already operating under it.



What you will actually do



• Resolve complex escalations: Own difficult technical issues that have exhausted the normal support troubleshooting path.

• Take command during severity i
: When a serious technical i
 occurs, lead the technical response, establish priorities, coordinate troubleshooting, and drive service restoration.

• Find the real cause: Hypothesize, isolate, test and prove. Clearly distinguish between what the evidence confirms, what you are inferring, and what is still unknown.

• Own complex network escalations: Troubleshoot network connectivity, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VLAN and related infrastructure problems through root cause and permanent resolution.

• Design and build client networks: Design, provision, configure, deploy and validate network environments for new clients, new locations and network refreshes.

• Configure network infrastructure: Work hands-on with firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, VLANs, routing, DHCP, DNS and other network services required to deliver reliable client environments.

• Own Microsoft 365 escalations: Investigate complex Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity, authentication, access and cloud-related issues that the support team cannot resolve.

• Document root cause: Major i
 should leave behind clear technical documentation explaining what happened, how it was proven, what resolved it, and what needs to change permanently.

• Look for patterns: When an issue repeats, investigate whether it points to a larger systemic problem rather than treating every occurrence as an unrelated ticket.

• Engineer workarounds when necessary: When permanent remediation cannot happen immediately, develop a safe workaround that restores service while ensuring the permanent correction remains tracked.

• Feed the automation pipeline: Identify repetitive and systemic technical problems that should be eliminated through automation and work with our Cloud Automation Engineers to make that happen.

• Improve documentation: Turn difficult i
 and discoveries into useful technical documentation, KBs, standards and troubleshooting guidance.

• Teach the support team: Lead monthly technical knowledge sessions based on real escalations and recurring issues so the team's troubleshooting capability continues to improve.

• Return incomplete escalations: When required troubleshooting or documentation has not been completed, return the escalation with clear direction on what is missing.

• Support new-client onboarding: Provide senior technical input where network, infrastructure, Microsoft 365 or other complex technical requirements need to be understood, redesigned or implemented.





Who we are looking for

You are genuinely curious about why things break.

A solution that suddenly starts working again without anyone understanding why should bother you.

When something fails, you want evidence.

You naturally separate what you know from what you suspect. You form a hypothesis, test it, eliminate possibilities and adjust your approach when the evidence proves your original assumption wrong.

You are equally comfortable troubleshooting a problem that already exists and building an environment correctly from the beginning.

You can move between Microsoft 365, networking, infrastructure and applications without assuming that the symptom necessarily identifies the layer where the actual problem exists.

You are comfortable being hands-on. Your networking experience is not limited to recommending products, creating diagrams or handing a design to somebody else. You understand how networks are actually configured, deployed, tested and troubleshot.

You remain composed when the situation is serious.

When logs are incomplete, users are down and a client wants an answer immediately, you can clearly explain what is known, what is being investigated and what happens next without guessing.

And you finish.

Root-cause work frequently happens after the emergency is over. Nobody may be standing over you asking why yesterday's i
 occurred. You still go back, complete the investigation, document it, identify the pattern and make sure the permanent work gets done.

Otherwise, this role becomes another level of support.

That is not what we are building.

YOU WILL NEED

• Deep hands-on diagnostic experience across infrastructure, networking, cloud and application layers

• Proven hands-on Microsoft 365 troubleshooting experience

• Proven hands-on networking experience, including both troubleshooting and implementation

• Experience designing, building, provisioning and configuring business networks

• Strong working knowledge of firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing and network security

• The ability to troubleshoot across multiple layers rather than assuming the first apparent cause is the real one

• A structured troubleshooting methodology you can clearly explain, including how you isolate variables and prove root cause

• Strong i
-management instincts and the ability to remain calm during live client-impacting i

• Strong written technical documentation skills

• The ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technicians and nontechnical stakeholders

• The judgment to recognize when something should remain with the support team rather than becoming an escalation

• The discipline to continue root-cause investigation after service has been restored

• The ability and willingness to teach other technicians

• Availability during Philippines hours aligned with US Eastern operations, through 18:30 ET at the latest





BONUS POINTS FOR

• Healthcare facility or regulated-industry IT experience

• HaloPSA experience

• Strong Azure experience

• Microsoft Intune experience

• Microsoft Entra ID experience

• Experience leading a major i
 in a live client environment

• Experience deploying or administering business networking platforms

• Existing Microsoft 365 certifications

• Existing UniFi certifications



CERTIFICATION WE FUND



• Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert - Required

• UniFi Full Stack Professional - Required



We pay for the required training, the first exam attempt, and the time required to take it. A resit following an unsuccessful attempt is self-funded.



What this role is not

• It is not second-line support - If you want a permanently full ticket queue and success measured primarily by ticket count, this role will feel strange. Your time is intentionally protected, so you can investigate problems properly, determine root cause, and eliminate recurring issues rather than simply moving from one ticket to another.

• It is not a management seat. You have no direct reports. Your influence comes from technical credibility, ownership, documentation, and teaching, not from managing a team.

• It is not a heroics seat. The measure is repeat i
 eliminated, not i
 attended. Being indispensable in a crisis is easy; making the crisis stop recurring is the job.

• It is not client-facing in the relationship sense. You will be on client calls during i
. The relationship stays with the PAM, and you hand it back when the i
 closes.

What you will get

• Protected time to think - Written into the model, defended by your manager, and the reason this seat exists at all.

• Fixes that stay fixed - A route from your root cause analysis into an automation engineer's sprint, so the problem you solved does not come back in a different client.

• Purpose you can commit to - Every recurring fault you eliminate contributes to eliminating repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers by 2050.

• Only hard problems - The PAM gate means the trivial never reaches you. Everything on your desk is genuinely difficult.

• A visible route on - Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect and Central Services Manager are all reachable from here, and all written down.

About ElasticlT



We are building a world where healthcare workers never wait for technology. We specialize in healthcare IT for healthcare facilities, providing managed services, automation and HIPAA-compliant solutions so medical and care professionals can focus on their residents rather than their systems.



Our North Star is simple and audacious: by 2050 we will eliminate repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers. Our purpose is to deliver the impossible under pressure, so that organizations transform their perception of what is possible.



OUR VALUES



SIMPLIFY THE OVERWHELMING: Cut through confusion with clarity and convert half-hour tasks into one-click wins

RESCUE WHEN OTHERS PANIC: Respond when others would panic and deliver the impossible under pressure

BUILD LASTING CAPABILITY: create tools that spread like wildfire and teams that work without micromanaging

PERSIST THROUGH CHAOS: Adapt when goalposts keep moving and turn disasters into relationships

ENABLE HUMAN PURPOSE: Remove barriers so the focus can be on patients, not systems



"The best week in this job is a quiet one, because it means the last three months Of

root cause work actually held. That is a strange thing to optimize for and it is exactly

what we are asking you to do."



How to apply:

Fill out this form - forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=mSS-jteCcUa2SUvZ2Pn71DLj3g8jt9NFjsUkZjVNOzBUNDA0M1oyOTZJSTFNVjEyRjBHTlA5Rko0Ni4u

title: Airbnb Operations Backup Coordinator
description:
About the Position



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Airbnb Operations Backup Coordinator to support our Lead Airbnb Manager in overseeing the daily operations of a short-term rental property located in Seminole, Florida, USA.

This is a remote, part-time, on-call position designed to provide additional operational support and ensure a smooth guest experience.



The ideal candidate must have excellent English communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently when needed.



Important: This position does not have a fixed daily schedule or guaranteed working hours. The selected candidate must be available to provide support Monday through Sunday, as needed. Compensation is based on actual productive working hours, not general standby availability.



Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Communication and Reservation Management

Monitor Airbnb and VRBO platforms for upcoming reservations, guest inquiries, and booking updates.

Respond professionally and promptly to guest messages when assigned.

Send pre-arrival instructions and check-in reminders.

Assist guests with property access, Wi-Fi information, and general questions.

Follow up with guests after check-in to ensure a positive experience.

Send checkout reminders and post-stay messages.

Assist with guest reviews and feedback management.

Escalate complaints, disputes, and unusual situations to the Lead Airbnb Manager.



2. Check-In and Check-Out Coordination

Assist with generating and updating guest access codes through the Ubiquiti smart lock system.

Coordinate access code verification with the cleaning team.

Ensure guests receive their check-in instructions on time.

Monitor guest check-in and check-out activity.

Follow established procedures to confirm property departures.

Ensure access codes are changed after each guest stay.



3. Cleaning and Property Turnover Coordination

Communicate upcoming checkouts and arrivals to the assigned cleaning team.

Coordinate cleaning schedules according to reservations.

Send cleaning and turnover checklists.

Review submitted cleaning reports, photos, and walkthrough videos.

Follow up on incomplete cleaning tasks.

Confirm that the property is ready before the next guest arrives.

Report cleaning concerns or delays to the Lead Airbnb Manager.



4. Maintenance and Inventory Support

Track property maintenance concerns and reported damages.

Submit and monitor maintenance requests through the company's internal system.

Coordinate with approved vendors when instructed.

Follow up on pending maintenance issues.

Assist with Amazon restocking requests.

Monitor inventory reports and identify missing supplies.

Immediately escalate urgent property concerns, such as water leaks, power outages, air-conditioning failures, or access issues.



5. Administrative and Reporting Tasks

Maintain accurate records of reservations, cleanings, guest communications, and maintenance requests.

Assist in preparing weekly property operations reports.

Track completed cleaning services for biweekly payment reports.

Monitor guest reviews and ratings.

Keep operational checklists and tracking documents updated.

Complete additional administrative tasks assigned by the Lead Airbnb Manager.



6. Backup Support and Operational Coverage

Act as the designated backup for the Lead Airbnb Manager.

Independently handle assigned Airbnb operations when the Lead Manager is unavailable.

Provide support during weekends, holidays, or unexpected guest situations when needed.

Maintain clear communication regarding completed tasks and pending responsibilities.

Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Ensure uninterrupted guest service during assigned coverage periods.



Qualifications and Requirements



Required



Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Previous experience in customer service, virtual assistance, administrative support, or a related field.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Professional and friendly communication style.

Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Drive).

Ability to learn new software and follow detailed procedures.

Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for remote work.

Ability to respond to assigned responsibilities during weekdays and weekends, as needed.



Preferred



Previous experience with Airbnb or VRBO.

Experience in short-term rental or property management.

Familiarity with guest communication and reservation management.

Experience coordinating cleaning services, maintenance, or vendors.

Familiarity with smart locks or remote property access systems.



Work Schedule and Availability

Schedule: Flexible, part-time, on-call.

Availability: Monday through Sunday, as needed.

Time Zone: Eastern Time (ET), United States.

Guaranteed Hours: None.

Work Location: Fully remote.



This position requires flexibility because guest requests, check-ins, checkouts, and unexpected situations may occur throughout the week.



The employee will be contacted when assistance is required by the Lead Airbnb Manager or when guest-related situations need attention.



Compensation and Time Tracking



Hourly Rate: $2.50 USD

Payment is based exclusively on actual hours spent performing assigned Airbnb-related duties.



General standby availability is unpaid, subject to applicable employment laws.

The employee will only be compensated for actual working time, including guest communications, reservation management, cleaning coordination, reporting, and other assigned responsibilities.

There is no guaranteed minimum number of paid hours.



All actual working time must be accurately recorded through the company's designated timekeeping system.

The employee must clock in when starting work and clock out when work is completed.

All recorded working hours are subject to review and approval.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate must demonstrate:

Responsiveness: Promptly address assigned guest inquiries and operational requests.

Reliability: Be dependable during agreed-upon coverage periods.

Accuracy: Maintain organized and accurate records.

Initiative: Identify potential issues and communicate them before they affect guests.

Accountability: Complete assigned tasks and accurately report actual working hours.

Professionalism: Maintain positive and respectful communication with guests, coworkers, and vendors.

Flexibility: Adapt to changing reservations, guest needs, and operational priorities.



Who We Are Looking For



This position is ideal for someone who:

Is seeking flexible, part-time remote work.

Has previous experience as a virtual assistant, Airbnb assistant, or customer service representative.

Is comfortable working with varying workloads.

Is organized, proactive, and detail-oriented.

Can follow instructions and established procedures.

Understands the importance of excellent hospitality and customer service.

Can provide dependable backup assistance when the Lead Airbnb Manager needs support.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit:



An updated resume in English.

A brief description of any Airbnb, VRBO, property management, or virtual assistant experience.

Their availability for on-call support, including weekends.

Confirmation that they understand the $2.50 USD hourly rate, flexible schedule, and payment based on actual working hours only.



Join our team and help us provide an excellent experience for every guest!

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Cold Caller, Remote Cold Caller, Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, B2B Cold Caller, Outbound Sales Representative, Outbound Appointment Setter, Sales Appointment Setter, Telemarketing Representative, Telesales Representative, Lead Generation Specialist, Sales Development Representative, SDR, Business Development Representative, BDR, Outbound Call Center Agent, Virtual Assistant – Cold Calling, Phone Sales Representative

Send follow-up
s and text messages when necessary.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINKELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Identify decision-makers and schedule callbacks or appointments.

Communicate feedback and common objections to the team.



Requirements

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

Experience making a large number of calls daily.

Ability to follow a defined process and use scripts effectively.

Strong conversational and listening skills.

Comfortable handling rejection and maintaining a positive attitude.

Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience calling businesses or working in B2B sales.

Familiarity with CRMs and dialing software.

Experience working remotely.







What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Freight Sales Hunter Wanted | We Pay for Results, Not Activity
description:
Remote | Philippines | U.S. Freight & Logistics



CAN YOU TURN A COLD PROSPECT INTO A PAYING CUSTOMER? PROVE IT. 



We're not looking for someone who simply makes calls, sends
s, or fills a CRM with leads.



We're looking for a proven Sales & Business Development Professional who knows how to find opportunities, win customers, and generate real revenue.



Our philosophy is simple: WE PAY FOR RESULTS.



Making 100 calls means little if none turn into business. Booking meetings is a start, but bringing in paying customers is what matters.



We value performance, accountability, and measurable contributions to business growth.



What You'll Be Responsible For:

- Identify and connect with U.S. and Canadian shippers needing freight and logistics services.

- Generate qualified prospects and convert them into actual paying customers.

- Build and manage your own sales pipeline, from initial outreach to customer acquisition.

- Develop creative, effective prospecting and business development strategies.

- Establish long-term relationships with shippers and decision-makers.

- Track and report measurable results, including qualified leads, conversions, customers acquired, and revenue generated.

- Take full ownership of your sales performance.



Who We're Looking For:

- 3+ years of proven sales and business development experience in freight, trucking, transportation, or logistics.

- U.S. freight brokerage or 3PL experience is mandatory.

- Demonstrated success in acquiring customers and generating revenue.

- Strong understanding of prospecting, lead qualification, sales pipelines, and closing strategies.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, 
, LinkedIn, or similar prospecting tools.

- Excellent English communication and negotiation skills.

- Independent, creative, resourceful, and highly results-driven.

- Someone who doesn't need constant supervision to get things done.



WE DON'T WANT PROMISES. WE WANT NUMBERS.



Before we consider your application, tell us what you've actually accomplished.

1. Lead Generation: How many qualified leads did you generate monthly?

2. Sales Conversion: How many prospects became paying customers?

3. Revenue: How much monthly revenue did you personally generate or contribute?

4. Performance: What percentage of your sales targets did you consistently achieve?

5. Biggest Win: What was your most successful sales achievement, and what were the actual numbers behind it?



We want specific, measurable achievements from your previous employers or clients.



NOT JUST " I HAVE 5 YEARS OF SALES EXPERIENCE."



Tell us what those five years produced.



Performance Matters. Results Get Rewarded.

We believe compensation should reflect the value and business results you deliver.

- We recognize measurable sales performance, not just hours worked or activities completed.

- Customer acquisition, revenue generation, and business growth are our key measures of success.

- We value people who take initiative, deliver results, and consistently exceed expectations.

- Performance-based compensation and incentives will be discussed with qualified candidates.



The goal isn't to look busy. The goal is to bring in business.



How to Apply



Please submit:

- Link to your updated resume.

- A brief summary of your U.S. freight/logistics sales experience.

- Your top 3 measurable sales achievements, including actual numbers.

- Examples of customers acquired, revenue generated, or successful sales campaigns.

- Your expected monthly compensation/commission in USD.



 Subject: I BRING RESULTS – [Your Name]



One Last Thing



This is NOT an entry-level position.



If you're looking for a role where making calls, sending
s, and completing daily activities are considered enough, this isn't it.



But if you're an experienced freight sales professional who knows how to turn opportunities into revenue, we'd like to hear from you.
