title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing health and fitness company hiring a Junior Software Engineer to help build and ship our mobile and web apps. This is a part-time or full-time contract (20 to 40 hours a week, depending on experience), with room to grow into a senior engineer with us.



This is not a job where you get a ticket, write code alone, and hand it off. You will build features end to end across iOS, Android and web, test them on real phones, fix what breaks, and ship them.



Our app brings together hardware control, AI coaching, community and subscriptions under one account. That means real challenges: Bluetooth device pairing, sign-in and
 verification, in-app purchases, subscriptions, and connecting to e-commerce and billing systems.



SCHEDULE

- Part-time or full-time contract, 20 to 40 hours a week, remote.

- Your hours must overlap with 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern time. That is 10 PM to 6 AM Philippine time from November to March, and 9 PM to 5 AM the rest of the year.

- Active on Slack during working hours and comfortable with short calls.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build mobile features for iOS and Android: screens, navigation, account flows and settings.

- Build and maintain web pages and web apps that use the same accounts and data as the mobile app.

- Build and test Bluetooth (BLE) connections so users can pair and control a physical device from their phone.

- Build sign-in and account flows:
 verification, login and account linking.

- Connect to our systems through APIs (Shopify, Recharge and our own backend) to check purchases and unlock the right features.

- Work with Apple in-app purchases, Google Play Billing and web checkout.

- Build locked and preview states so users who do not own a product see a helpful preview, not a blank screen.

- Test your own work on real iPhones and Android phones before anything ships.

- Prepare builds for TestFlight, Google Play testing, and App Store and Google Play review.

- Find and fix bugs reported by testers and customers, fast.

- Use AI coding tools every day, while understanding every line you ship.



OUR STACK (familiarity preferred, not expertise in all)

- Mobile: React Native / Expo, or native Swift and Kotlin

- Web: JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS

- Backend and data: Node.js, REST APIs, Postgres or Firebase/Supabase

- Hardware: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) libraries for mobile

- Payments: Apple StoreKit, Google Play Billing, RevenueCat, Shopify, Recharge

- Shipping: Git/GitHub, TestFlight, Google Play Console, Expo EAS or similar

- Tools: Slack, 
, Notion, and AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and GitHub Copilot



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have built and shipped at least one app on BOTH the App Store and Google Play, and you are comfortable building for the web.

- You take a feature from idea to tested release without every step spelled out.

- You learn fast: when you hit something new, like Bluetooth or billing, you read the docs and figure it out.

- You test on real devices and catch problems before customers do.

- You care whether the app feels simple and clear, not just whether the code runs.

- You try first, then ask a clear question with what you already tried.

- You want a long-term role and to grow with the company.



NOT A FIT IF

- You have only built web apps and never shipped a mobile app (or the reverse).

- You only want to write code and not test, debug or handle releases.

- You copy AI-generated code without understanding it.

- You go quiet when you are stuck.

- You cannot be online for most of US Eastern business hours.

- You are only looking for short one-off freelance projects.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We’re looking for a sales-driven professional with technical knowledge to support the sales and customer operations of the U.S.-based business specializing in duct-cleaning equipment and supplies.



You’ll handle customer inquiries and orders, recommend suitable products and accessories, maintain customer relationships, and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical problem-solving with sales and customer service skills.



Responsibilities

- Manage incoming customer inquiries, product questions, and orders for duct-cleaning equipment, vacuums, tools, parts, and accessories.

- Understand customer needs by asking the right questions and recommending appropriate products, compatible components, and additional items when relevant.

- Prepare and follow up on quotes, orders, and customer requests, ensuring accurate and timely handling.

- Build relationships with existing customers through proactive follow-ups and identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, and cross-selling.

- Contact inactive customers to update their information, understand their current needs, and explore opportunities to reengage them.

- Maintain accurate customer records, contact details, and sales activity in Salesforce.

- Review and update customer account information, including identifying inactive or closed accounts and helping align records between Salesforce and the company's order-processing system.

- Learn the product line, how the equipment works, and how different tools and components are used together to help customers make informed purchasing decisions.

- Work closely with the sales team to manage day-to-day customer needs and help qualify potential sales opportunities, allowing senior team members to focus on larger accounts and business development.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in inside sales, technical sales, account management, customer service, or a related customer-facing role.

- HVAC experience is highly preferred. A background in plumbing, electrical work, mechanical services, equipment repair, facilities maintenance, or a similar technical field is also relevant.

- Strong technical understanding and the ability to understand how equipment, tools, and components work together.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to ask relevant questions and understand customer needs.

- A sales-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify sales opportunities, recommend relevant products, and develop customer relationships.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing customer accounts, inquiries, and orders.

- Experience using CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.

- Ability to learn technical products and processes through training and apply that knowledge to customer inquiries.

- Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple requests independently while collaborating with the team.

- Previous experience working with U.S.-based clients.

- Must be available to work graveyard shifts aligned with U.S. time zones, including U.S. Eastern Time.

- Experience as a Team Lead or Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a plus.

- Must have a reliable internet connection and a dedicated work-from-home setup.



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: PHP 55,000 per month

- Additional monthly incentives, estimated at PHP 15,000+

- 100% remote / work-from-home

- PTO and paid holidays

title: Staffing Operations Specialist
description:
We're looking for a Staffing Operations Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as their first offshore operations hire.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will help make sure staffing requests are handled quickly, shifts are fulfilled, and both workers and clients have the support they need.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle issues quickly as they come up.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Flexible and comfortable taking on different types of work as priorities change.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to solve problems, improve workflows, or automate tasks.

- Comfortable learning new systems and working with technology.

- Willing to speak up, share ideas, and give feedback when something isn't working.

- Must be available to work U.S. time zones.

100% WFH

title: AI Video Content Creator For TikTok
description:
Job Description



- Design and manage a unique AI avatar that consistently looks the same for a tiktok profile. The images of the avatar will be provided and consistency of the avatar throughout new videos is extremely important. Realism is key. 

- Create AI generated content with that avatar built around select Tiktok products where the AI avatar will look as realistic as possible and use or demonstrate the listed products for that week.

o Videos lengths will vary from 20 seconds to 1 min.

o General scripts will be given to follow; however, modification of the script is required so it’s not an exact copy.

o Creativity is required to create modified versions of the same video, but with different backgrounds and hooks.

o Job entails approximately 20-35 videos per week all centered around select Tiktok product.

o The needed tools and programs will be discussed if hired



To be considered, please submit the following:



1. I will send you a video where you will create a copy of that video with a AI generated avatar demonstrating or using the product in the video. Follow the format and script given in the example video and create your own version with a new avatar and voice. The importance is that the new video is as close to the original as possible and that it looks as real as possible.

2. The script and video to copy from will be provided along with images of the product.

3. Details matter. The product needs to look exactly like the product in the given images and there can be no exaggeration.

4. Candidates with the best desired outcome will be considered for the position. Do your best work!

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Real Estate Admin VA (Transaction/Listing Coordinator)
description:
Are you the detail-oriented, deadline-driven Real Estate Listing Coordinator we’ve been looking for?

We’re hiring a Remote Real Estate Listing Coordinator to support our U.S.-based real estate business. This is a work-from-home position where you’ll manage listings from onboarding to active status, ensure accuracy across platforms, and keep all listing-related tasks on track.



If you’re highly organized, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy keeping listings compliant and up to date, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities:

- Coordinate new listings from onboarding through activation and updates.

- Enter, manage, and update listings in MLS and other listing platforms.

- Collect, organize, and maintain listing documents, disclosures, and property details.

- Coordinate with agents, sellers, photographers, and vendors.

- Track listing deadlines and ensure compliance with MLS and brokerage requirements.

- Make price changes, status updates, and listing revisions as needed.

- Maintain accurate records and communicate listing updates to the team.



What We’re Looking For:

title: Senior Customer Success Specialist
description:
Company: Outbound Power  

Location: Remote  

Employment Type: Full-Time  

Salary: $1,400 USD/month  

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Arizona Mountain Standard Time



Applicants must be comfortable working these hours, which correspond to an overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Please note: All applications and communications outside of OnlineJobs.ph will not be accepted.



About Outbound Power



Outbound Power is a growing U.S.-based e-commerce company specializing in portable power stations, solar generators, battery storage, home backup systems, and off-grid power solutions.



Our mission is simple: To help people take control of their power.



We believe customers deserve knowledgeable, friendly, human support when making important purchasing decisions.



We are looking for an experienced, highly capable Senior Customer Success Specialist who can independently manage customer relationships, resolve challenging situations, and consistently deliver exceptional service.



This is not an entry-level customer service position. We are looking for someone who brings substantial experience, confidence, sound judgment, and a strong sense of personal responsibility to their work.



Our Core Values



Our company operates around three core values. These values are extremely important to us, and we expect every team member to demonstrate them consistently.



1. Highly Dependable



We do what we say we will do.



We take ownership of our responsibilities, follow through on commitments, communicate proactively, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work.



Our customers and teammates should never have to wonder whether something will get done.



2. Creative



We look for solutions, not excuses.



We think independently, solve problems, find better ways of doing things, and take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.



When something is not working, we look for ways to improve it.



3. Positive



We bring a friendly, helpful, and solutions-oriented attitude to everything we do.



We treat customers and teammates with kindness, patience, and respect—even when situations are difficult.



We believe a positive attitude is a choice, and we strive to make every interaction a good experience.



These are not simply words on a page. They are the standards by which we hire, recognize, and evaluate our team members.



About the Role



As a Senior Customer Success Specialist, you will take ownership of customer inquiries, problems, and relationships throughout the purchasing journey.



You will communicate directly with customers through phone calls,
, SMS, and live chat.



You will independently investigate and resolve customer issues, make appropriate decisions within company guidelines, coordinate with suppliers, and ensure customers receive timely, accurate assistance.



We expect you to use your experience and judgment to make decisions rather than routinely escalating problems or waiting for instructions.



You will have the authority to resolve appropriate customer issues within established company policies and approval limits.



You should be comfortable handling difficult conversations, making judgment calls, and taking responsibility for the outcome of your decisions.



You will also help customers make informed purchasing decisions and identify opportunities to recommend products that genuinely meet their needs.



This is primarily a customer success position, not a traditional outbound sales role.



Key Responsibilities



Customer Communication & Support

- Independently manage customer inquiries through phone,
, SMS, and live chat.

- Provide confident, professional, and knowledgeable customer assistance.

- Handle complex or sensitive customer situations with minimal supervision.

- Communicate clearly and decisively, even when customers are frustrated or demanding.

- Follow up proactively without requiring reminders.

- Ensure customers receive prompt, accurate, and helpful responses.

- Maintain a high standard of professionalism in every interaction.



Problem Resolution & Independent Decision-Making

- Take full ownership of customer issues from initial contact through resolution.

- Investigate problems, evaluate available options, and determine appropriate solutions.

- Make independent decisions within established company policies and approval limits.

- Resolve shipping delays, order discrepancies, product concerns, and other customer issues.

- Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers to resolve customer problems.

- Recognize when an issue genuinely requires escalation rather than automatically seeking management approval.

- Anticipate potential problems and take proactive steps to prevent them.

- Accept accountability for decisions and follow through on commitments.

- Document decisions and resolutions clearly.



Product Knowledge & Sales Assistance

- Develop a strong working knowledge of our products, brands, and solutions.

- Confidently assist customers with product comparisons and purchasing decisions.

- Identify appropriate accessories and complementary products.

- Follow up with interested customers and help them complete their purchases.

- Recognize when specialized technical expertise is required.

- Continuously improve product knowledge through training and independent research.



Organization & Team Collaboration

- Independently prioritize customer inquiries and competing responsibilities.

- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and outstanding issues.

- Ensure important follow-ups and commitments are completed without reminders.

- Collaborate effectively with sales, technical support, and administrative team members.

- Identify recurring customer service problems and recommend improvements.

- Help improve customer service procedures and operational efficiency.

- Demonstrate reliability and accountability in a remote working environment.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:

- Independently handle the majority of customer inquiries and issues.

- Confidently resolve challenging customer situations within established guidelines.

- Make sound decisions without requiring frequent management involvement.

- Consistently follow through on commitments without reminders.

- Maintain organized records and reliable follow-up practices.

- Communicate proactively when issues require attention.

- Demonstrate excellent judgment, professionalism, and customer service skills.

- Consistently embody our core values of being Highly Dependable, Creative, and Positive.



Required Qualifications

- Minimum 4 years of professional customer service or customer success experience.

- Demonstrated experience independently resolving complex customer issues.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence communicating directly with American customers.

- Strong decision-making skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment.

- Proven ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Experience handling difficult customer conversations and resolving complaints professionally.

- Excellent problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience communicating with customers by phone,
, and live chat.

- Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and manage a demanding workload.

- Comfortable learning new products, software, and procedures.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional environment for customer calls.

- A demonstrated history of dependability, accountability, and consistent performance.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working for a U.S.-based e-commerce company.

- Experience using Shopify.

- Experience with customer service platforms, CRM software, and live chat systems.

- Experience handling escalated customer complaints or complex service issues.

- Experience making independent customer service decisions within company guidelines.

- Experience coordinating with suppliers or manufacturers to resolve customer issues.

- Familiarity with portable power stations, generators, solar equipment, or related products.

- Experience assisting customers with purchasing decisions and following up on sales inquiries.



The Ideal Candidate



Is this you?

- You are an experienced customer service professional who takes your responsibilities seriously.

- You are confident in your abilities and comfortable making decisions.

- You do not need someone constantly telling you what to do.

- You take ownership of problems and see them through to resolution.

- You know when to act independently and when escalation is genuinely necessary.

- You remain calm, professional, and decisive under pressure.

- You are comfortable handling demanding or dissatisfied customers.

- You communicate proactively rather than waiting to be asked for updates.

- You are exceptionally dependable and follow through on every commitment.

- You think creatively and look for practical solutions.

- You have a genuinely positive attitude and treat others with respect.

- You take pride in your work and hold yourself to high standards.

- You welcome accountability and constructive feedback.

- You are eager to learn and continually improve.



Above all, you consistently demonstrate our three core values: Highly Dependable, Creative, and Positive.



Compensation & Benefits

- $1,200 USD per month starting salary

- Full-time, remote position

- Monday–Friday schedule aligned with Arizona business hours

- 10 paid vacation days per year

- Initial one-month trial period

- Long-term career opportunity with a growing U.S. company

- Opportunities for professional development and advancement



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Resume



Highlight your customer service experience, particularly roles involving independent decision-making, complex problem resolution, and direct communication with customers.



2. Relevant Experience



Describe your experience handling challenging customer situations, making independent decisions, and resolving problems without management intervention.



3. Customer Service Screening Question



A customer contacts you because their $3,000 power station order has not shipped as expected.



They are extremely frustrated because they purchased the equipment for an upcoming trip and are worried it will not arrive in time.



You discover that the manufacturer has delayed fulfillment and cannot provide a confirmed shipping date.



The customer demands an immediate solution and threatens to dispute the charge with their credit card company.



Your manager is unavailable.



Please explain:

- Exactly how you would respond to the customer.

- What immediate actions you would take.

- What solutions you would consider offering.

- What decisions you would make independently.

- Under what circumstances you would escalate the issue.

- How you would follow through until the situation is resolved.



We are evaluating your judgment, confidence, communication skills, and ability to independently resolve challenging customer situations.



4. Core Values Question



Our three core values are Highly Dependable, Creative, and Positive.



Describe a specific situation from your previous employment where you independently solved a difficult customer problem.



Explain:

- What happened.

- What decision you made.

- Why you made that decision.

- What the outcome was.

- How your actions demonstrated our core values.



Please provide a real example rather than a hypothetical situation.



5. Subject Line/Title



The subject line/title of your response must be “I am a Customer Success Superstar."



6. Cover Letter



Include a cover letter with one paragraph of three lines or less in blue 16 font and tell me about yourself and why you would be a great fit for this position.



7. Recording



Please include a brief voice memo and/or video introducing yourself (one minute is fine).



Tell us about your professional customer service experience, your approach to solving difficult problems, and why you believe you would excel in this position.

title: SMALL ENGINE MECHANIC – REMOTE TECHNICAL SUPPORT
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced small engine mechanic based in the Philippines to provide remote technical support to North American customers.



This position requires substantial professional repair experience, advanced diagnostic ability, excellent spoken and written English, and strong computer skills. The successful candidate must be able to explain technical issues clearly, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple customer cases accurately and professionally.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Diagnose complex engine problems remotely through phone calls, chat, photographs, and video.



• Guide customers through diagnostic checks, testing, and repairs using clear, straightforward English.



• Identify the correct replacement parts using equipment model, type, code, and serial numbers.



• Read and interpret service manuals, wiring diagrams, and illustrated parts diagrams.



• Diagnose faults involving fuel delivery, ignition, compression, electrical systems, governors, valvetrains, charging systems, and internal engine components.



• Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, diagnostic findings, troubleshooting steps, and recommendations.



• Communicate patiently and professionally with customers who have varying levels of mechanical knowledge.



• Manage multiple customer cases, prioritize outstanding issues, and follow through without compromising accuracy or service quality.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Five or more years of professional, hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing small engines.



• Advanced knowledge of 2-stroke and 4-stroke engines, including their operation, maintenance, and repair.



• Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and a professional telephone manner.



• Excellent written English, including strong grammar, spelling, and reading comprehension.



• Ability to explain technical information and repair instructions clearly and naturally to North American customers.



• Strong computer proficiency, including efficient typing,
 and chat communication, online research, and navigation between multiple applications.



• A reliable computer, quality headset, high-speed internet, a backup internet connection, and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Ten or more years of professional small engine repair experience.



• Previous experience as a lead technician, shop foreman, service manager, technical adviser, or instructor.



• Experience diagnosing and repairing engines or equipment from Briggs & Stratton, Honda, Kohler, Kawasaki, Stihl, Husqvarna, Yamaha, Generac, Tecumseh, or comparable manufacturers.



• Familiarity with equipment commonly used in North America and the terminology customers use to describe it.



• Experience using electronic parts catalogs, service databases, ticketing systems, or customer management software.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



• Your résumé outlining your professional mechanical experience.



• A two-minute, unedited introduction in English, submitted as a video or voice recording.



• A brief written summary of your mechanical experience, including the engines, equipment, and types of repairs you have worked on.



• A written response to this diagnostic scenario: An engine cranks but will not start. Explain the steps you would take to identify the cause and why.



• Details of your internet speed, backup internet connection, and available working hours, including your time zone.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will complete:



• A live interview conducted in English.



• A written English and customer service assessment.



• A practical small engine diagnostic interview.



• A computer proficiency and online research assessment.



Only applicants who meet all required qualifications will be considered.

title: YouTube & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
DO NOT MESSAGE ON OLJ FOR INTEREST - THOSE WHO SUBMIT APPLICATION VIA GOOGLE FORM WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR INTERVIEW:



Location: Remote



Rate: $6 - $8/hour



Employment Type: Contractor



Schedule:

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time (PST),

Monday - Friday (Full time - 8 hours - 1 hour lunch break)

**Candidates must be available to work these hours based on our headquarters’ time zone.





About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Video & Content Editor to help us grow our social media presence, including YoutTube & Shorts, Reels, and TikTok.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply splicing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how social media content works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.



Ideally, you also have experience creating long-form content for YouTube with supporting graphic design skills for thumbnails.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.

title: Marketing & Content Manager
description:
**START HERE**



Your application must begin with the word **BLUEPRINT**.



If it does not, we will not review it.



This is intentional. Great marketing requires attention to detail, and this is the first way we test it.



**ABOUT US**



We are a Virginia-based real estate sales and coaching company serving agents across the US.



Our founder, Dan Rochon, is a TEDx speaker, host of the *No Broke Months* podcast, and author of *Teach to Sell*, published by Post Hill Press and distributed by Simon & Schuster.



Our work is built around one promise: helping real estate agents create **Consistent and Predictable Income — CPI**.



Dan has used this system since 2008 without having a broke month.



Today, the brand includes a book, podcast, coaching community, training, real estate sales organization, and agents producing meaningful results.



We already have the ideas.



We already have the stories.



We already have the content.



We need someone who can turn all of that into consistent attention.



**THE ROLE**



This is not a basic social media posting position.



You will help manage and grow the content engine behind the brand.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn.

* Prioritizing short form video and finding strong hooks, moments, and stories.

* Managing the *No Broke Months* podcast, including guest coordination, editing, publishing, show notes, and clips.

* Repurposing long form recordings into multiple pieces of content for different platforms.

* Supporting the marketing of *Teach to Sell*, including Amazon and Audible review campaigns.

* Identifying and sharing stories from our agents, including their wins, challenges, numbers, lessons, and transformations.

* Maintaining a reliable publishing calendar.

* Reviewing analytics and adjusting the content strategy based on actual performance.

* Providing a simple monthly report on reach, views, opt ins, applications, wins, misses, and next steps.



We do not need someone waiting for content assignments.



We need someone who sees the opportunity and moves.



**HOW WE WILL KNOW YOU ARE WINNING**



Content gets published consistently without someone asking for an update.



One strong recording turns into ten or more useful pieces of content.



Important clips do not sit untouched in folders.



You know which posts worked and which ones did not.



You can explain what the numbers are telling us.



You can look at last month's performance and confidently identify what should be repeated, improved, or stopped.



And the biggest sign of success:



The audience starts connecting with the people, stories, and results inside the community — not just the founder.



**YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF**



* You have at least 2 years of experience managing social media, content, or digital marketing for a US or international brand.

* You can show us real accounts, channels, or campaigns you have worked on.

* You personally know how to edit short form video using CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or similar tools.

* You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and continue watching.

* You can write clear, natural English that does not sound generic or templated.

* You can manage deadlines and a content calendar without being constantly reminded.

* You are comfortable looking at analytics and making decisions from them.

* You can take a long interview, podcast, or training and quickly identify the strongest moments.

* You can work at least four hours overlapping with US Eastern Time.

* You have reliable internet and a backup option if your connection goes down.



**THIS PROBABLY IS NOT FOR YOU IF**



* You mainly want to design graphics and schedule posts.

* You need someone else to tell you what to publish every day.

* You have never edited short form video yourself.

* You rarely review performance after posting.

* You wait for detailed instructions before taking action.

* You regularly miss publishing deadlines.

* You dislike having your work measured.

* You believe posting more automatically means the marketing is working.



This role has clear expectations and clear numbers.



**OUR HIRING PROCESS**



We believe the work should speak louder than the resume.



Every application goes through the same initial review using the AI evaluation system our agents use, built around twenty years of top-producer sales experience.



Qualified candidates will then complete a short practical assessment.



That may include:



* Writing three different hooks for a video we provide.

* Reviewing a piece of content that underperformed and explaining what you would change.

* Building a simple 90 day strategy for one social media channel.

* Recording a 60–90 second video explaining a piece of content you are proud of and why you believe it performed well.



Candidates who perform well move into a **paid two week trial**.



We believe a real working trial tells both sides more than another round of interviews.



At the end, we should both know whether this is the right fit.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Send your application with the following information, in this order:



* **BLUEPRINT** as the first word.

* A link to your **portfolio** showing your best marketing, social media, video, or content work.

* Links to two or three social media accounts or channels you have managed, along with what you personally handled.

* Two examples of short form videos you edited yourself.

* Your expected monthly salary in USD.

* One sentence explaining the best performing piece of content you have created and why you believe it worked.



Applications that follow the instructions will be reviewed.



Applications that do not will not.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper – Immediate Start | Cleanup & Reconciliation Project
description:

Glacier Exteriors is a growing roofing and exterior restoration company based in Colorado, USA.



I'm looking for an experienced, detail-oriented QuickBooks Online bookkeeper who can jump in immediately and help get our company's financial records cleaned up, reconciled, and ready for our accountant.



This will begin as a one-time cleanup project. Our business began operating in 2026, and we need to reconcile our transactions from the beginning of the year through the present.



Immediate Responsibilities:



Review and organize our existing QuickBooks Online accounts.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit card transactions.

Review, categorize, and correct transactions as needed.

Identify duplicate, missing, or incorrectly recorded transactions.

Properly categorize business expenses, owner contributions, and owner draws.

Review accounts payable and receivable for accuracy.

Prepare accurate financial reports, including Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet.

Ensure our books are clean, organized, and ready for our U.S. accountant.

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

Strong English communication skills.

title: Talent & Development Specialist
description:
Role Summary



PawPay is a growing company focused on delivering innovative financial solutions for the veterinary industry. As our team continues to expand, we are looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist who can take ownership of our employee training programs, learning materials, and professional development initiatives. We are looking for someone who is not only an experienced trainer but also a strong content creator, researcher, and LMS administrator who can independently develop engaging learning experiences.







Key Responsibilities



Training Material Development & Content Creation

Learning Management System (LMS) Administration

Training Facilitation & Employee Development

Research & Learning Program Improvement

Training Administration & Coordination

Others to follow



Qualifications



At least 2 years of professional experience as a Trainer, Training Specialist, Learning & Development Specialist, or similar role.

Hands-on experience creating training materials is mandatory, including presentations, instructional guides, e-learning modules, and assessments.

Practical experience using and administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is mandatory. Experience with TalentLMS, Moodle, Docebo, or similar platforms is acceptable.

Proven experience facilitating training sessions, preferably in a remote or virtual work environment.

Strong research skills, with the ability to independently gather, validate, and organize information into effective learning materials.

A creative eye for visual design, presentation layout, and engaging educational content.

Familiarity with training administration, including scheduling, attendance tracking, progress monitoring, reporting, and documentation.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Google Workspace, and other content creation tools.

Ability to work independently, proactively communicate updates, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Must be available to conduct training, onboarding, and coordination meetings during assigned PST working hours.





Preferred Candidate



We’re looking for someone who is:



Experience in BPO, SaaS, fintech, insurance, customer service, or other fast-paced industries.

Experience developing structured onboarding programs and employee certification pathways.

Familiarity with instructional design principles, such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, or adult learning methodologies.

Experience using AI-powered content creation and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gamma, or similar platforms.

Basic video editing, graphic design, or interactive course creation experience.

Experience conducting training needs analysis (TNA) and measuring training effectiveness.

Experience supporting leadership development, compliance training, and employee engagement initiatives.

What we're looking for: 



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the L&D function rather than simply facilitate training sessions.



Our ideal candidate is:



Creative: Can transform ordinary training content into engaging and visually appealing learning experiences.

Resourceful: Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics and independently developing learning materials.

Organized: Can manage training calendars, LMS assignments, attendance, deadlines, and reports without constant supervision.

Proactive: Regularly provides updates, identifies potential issues early, and follows through on commitments.

Confident Trainer: Comfortable conducting live virtual sessions and engaging employees with different experience levels.

Tech-Savvy: Familiar with digital learning platforms, collaboration tools, and AI-assisted content creation.

Dependable: Available during agreed working hours and responsive to training requests and team coordination.



If you’re someone who thrives in a results-oriented, entrepreneurial environment and wants to grow quickly, this is the right place for you.

title: Operations Manager / Client Success Manager (GoHighLevel + Automations)
description:
Plumbify helps residential plumbing companies generate qualified inbound calls and booked jobs through Google Ads, Local Services Ads, and Meta advertising.



We are growing fast and looking for a sharp, reliable operator who can own client onboarding, communication, systems, and delivery.



This is not a basic assistant role. We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions, disappears during work hours, or escalates every problem. We hold ourselves to a very high standard, and we will hold you to that same standard.



SCHEDULE

You must work U.S. business hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern (8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific). You will talk with clients across U.S. time zones.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Getting new clients launched quickly and correctly

- Managing onboarding from signed agreement through launch

- Chasing clients for missing information, access, assets, and approvals

- Handling client calls clearly and professionally

- Keeping every client, task, deadline, and deliverable organized

- Building and troubleshooting GoHighLevel workflows, domains, number pools, pipelines, and automations

- Managing integrations through Zapier, Make, webhooks, and call tracking tools

- QAing your own work before it reaches the client

- Solving problems on your own instead of escalating them

- Spotting risks before they become client fires

- Improving SOPs and helping build AI-assisted systems

- Coordinating with our ads team so launches happen smoothly



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

You will not run ads or campaign strategy. We have a dedicated ads team for that. Your job is client communication, internal coordination, follow-up, and solving operational issues to keep delivery moving.



Example: if a client hasn't provided what we need to launch, you will explain exactly what's missing, set a deadline, follow up until it's done, keep the client informed, and only escalate with a diagnosis and a recommended fix.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English with a clear accent. You will be on the phone with U.S. business owners

- Comfortable leading calls

- Strong GoHighLevel experience

- Experience with Zapier, Make, webhooks, automations, or call tracking

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable availability during U.S. hours

- Can manage multiple clients without constant supervision

- Stable internet, backup power, and a quiet work environment



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- You disappear during working hours

- You need the same task explained repeatedly

- You repeat mistakes without fixing the cause

- You escalate every problem without trying to solve it first

- You avoid client calls

- You don't want to be measured by results



COMPENSATION

$800 to $1,500/month base depending on experience, technical ability, communication, and ownership. We pay based on what you can prove you can own.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Send:

1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. A 2 to 3 minute Loom video answering:

   - Why are you a strong fit for this role?

   - How would you handle a client who hasn't provided what's needed to launch?

   - How would you handle an angry client whose launch is delayed?

   - Tell us about a technical problem you solved on your own.

   - What would success look like after 90 days?

3. Your GoHighLevel and automation experience

4. The U.S. hours you're available



Shortlisted candidates will do a paid technical and client-communication test.



If you're sharp, proactive, reliable, technically strong, and great with clients, apply.

title: Technical Product Specialist – Solar & Backup Power
description:
Company: Outbound Power  

Location: Remote  

Employment Type: Full-Time  

Salary: $1,500 USD/month  

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Arizona Mountain Standard Time



Applicants must be comfortable working these hours, which correspond to an overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Please note: All applications and communications outside of OnlineJobs.ph will not be accepted.



About Outbound Power



Outbound Power is a growing U.S.-based e-commerce company specializing in portable power stations, solar generators, battery storage, home backup systems, and off-grid power solutions.



Our mission is simple: To help people take control of their power.



We believe customers deserve knowledgeable, friendly, human support when making important purchasing decisions.



We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who has genuine expertise in solar, battery storage, inverters, and backup power systems.



About the Role



This is a technical position, not a sales position.



You will serve as our in-house technical expert, providing direct technical support to customers while helping our sales and customer service teams recommend the right power solutions.



You will answer technical questions, troubleshoot product issues, assist customers with product setup and operation, size and configure power systems, research product compatibility, and help develop customized solutions for residential, RV, off-grid, and commercial applications.



You will also help strengthen our team's technical knowledge through training and documentation.



We are looking for someone who understands how power systems actually work—not simply someone who knows product specifications.



Key Responsibilities



Technical Product & Customer Support

- Provide direct technical assistance to customers by phone,
, and live chat.

- Help customers with product setup, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting.

- Diagnose technical issues involving portable power stations, solar panels, batteries, inverters, and generators.

- Assist customers with system compatibility, connectivity, and integration questions.

- Explain technical concepts clearly to customers with varying levels of experience.

- Answer technical questions from our sales and customer service teams.

- Research and explain product specifications, capabilities, and limitations.

- Determine compatibility between batteries, inverters, solar panels, generators, and accessories.

- Coordinate with manufacturers when troubleshooting requires additional assistance, warranty service, or escalation.

- Document technical issues, solutions, and recommendations for future reference.



System Sizing & Configuration

- Calculate electrical loads, inverter requirements, battery capacity, and estimated runtime.

- Recommend appropriate solar and battery storage configurations.

- Help develop customized home backup, RV, off-grid, and commercial power solutions.

- Identify compatible components and necessary accessories.

- Evaluate system expandability and future customer requirements.

- Prepare clear technical recommendations for our sales team.

- Identify potential system limitations, compatibility concerns, and installation requirements.



Product Research & Team Training

- Stay current on new products and technologies.

- Review technical manuals, specifications, and manufacturer documentation.

- Help evaluate new products before they are added to our catalog.

- Create simple technical reference materials and troubleshooting guides for our team.

- Train sales and customer service representatives on product capabilities, compatibility, system sizing, and basic troubleshooting.

- Help our team become more technically knowledgeable and independent.



Required Qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of professional experience working with solar PV, battery energy storage systems, inverters, or related electrical power systems.

- Strong understanding of AC/DC electrical fundamentals.

- Ability to calculate power requirements, battery capacity, inverter sizing, and estimated runtime.

- Experience configuring or designing solar and battery storage systems.

- Understanding of solar charge controllers, hybrid inverters, and battery technologies.

- Ability to interpret technical specifications, electrical diagrams, and manufacturer documentation.

- Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting technical equipment or electrical power systems.

- Ability to communicate technical information clearly to nontechnical customers.

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently, conduct research, and solve problems without constant supervision.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with U.S.-based solar, renewable energy, or electrical equipment companies.

- Familiarity with U.S. residential electrical systems, including 120V/240V split-phase power.

- Experience with residential backup power and off-grid systems.

- Knowledge of generator integration, transfer switches, and hybrid power configurations.

- Familiarity with brands such as EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, EG4, Victron Energy, BLUETTI, or similar manufacturers.

- Previous experience as a solar system designer, technical support specialist, applications engineer, renewable energy technician, or technical customer support representative.

- Experience providing remote technical troubleshooting and customer assistance.

- Experience creating technical documentation or training materials.



The Ideal Candidate



Is this you?

- Genuinely enjoys learning about electrical and renewable energy systems.

- Understands the technical principles behind the equipment.

- Can confidently evaluate whether a proposed system will work.

- Enjoys troubleshooting problems and helping customers find solutions.

- Is patient, friendly, and professional when assisting customers.

- Enjoys researching complex technical questions.

- Takes initiative and finds answers independently.

- Can explain technical concepts in simple, understandable language.

- Is detail-oriented and takes accuracy seriously.

- Enjoys helping others develop their knowledge.

- Takes ownership of problems and follows through.



We particularly value technical competence, independent thinking, curiosity, excellent customer service, and accountability.



Compensation & Benefits

- $1,500 USD per month

- Full-time, remote position

- Monday–Friday schedule aligned with Arizona business hours

- Long-term career opportunity with a growing U.S. company

- Opportunity to become our lead technical product expert



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Resume



Highlight your experience with solar PV, battery storage, inverters, electrical power systems, and technical troubleshooting.



2. Relevant Experience



Briefly describe the types of power systems you have designed, configured, installed, supported, or troubleshot.



3. Technical Experience



List the solar, inverter, and battery brands you have worked with.



4. U.S. Industry Experience



Let us know whether you have previously worked with U.S.-based solar or renewable energy companies.



5. Technical Screening Question



A homeowner wants to power the following equipment during an outage:

- Refrigerator: 150W average consumption

- Wi-Fi router: 15W

- LED lighting: 50W

- Window air conditioner: 900W while running

- The homeowner wants approximately 8 hours of backup power.



Please explain:

- How you would estimate the required battery capacity.

- How you would determine the appropriate inverter size.

- What additional information you would need before recommending a system.

- Whether you would recommend solar panels and why.



Please show your calculations and explain your assumptions. We are interested in understanding your technical reasoning, not simply receiving a product recommendation.



6. Subject Line/Title



The subject line/title of your response must be “I am a Technical Product Superstar."



7. Cover Letter



Include a cover letter with one paragraph of three lines or less in blue 16 font and tell me about yourself and why you would be a great fit for this position.



8. Recording



Please include a brief voice memo and/or video introducing yourself (one minute is fine). Tell us about your technical background, relevant experience, and why you are interested in this position.

title: Airbnb / VRBO Listing Optimization & Revenue Management VA | PriceLabs Experience
description:
Revolve Vacation Rentals is a boutique luxury vacation rental management company based in Scottsdale, Arizona. We manage a growing portfolio of 30+ vacation rental properties and are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced Virtual Assistant to help us maximize listing performance, occupancy, and revenue.



**This is not a general administrative VA position.** We're looking for someone who understands short-term rentals, has hands-on experience with Airbnb and VRBO, and knows how to optimize listings to improve visibility, rankings, bookings, and revenue.



## Key Responsibilities



**Listing Management & Optimization**

- Regularly audit and optimize Airbnb and VRBO listings.

- Improve listing titles, descriptions, photo sequencing, amenities, and other details to increase conversions.

- Monitor listing quality, visibility, and performance.

- Identify opportunities to improve search rankings and booking conversion.

- Ensure listings remain accurate, consistent, and up to date across platforms.

- Research competing properties and identify opportunities to outperform the market.



**Revenue Management & Pricing**

- Monitor and adjust dynamic pricing strategies using PriceLabs.

- Review occupancy, average daily rates (ADR), RevPAR, and booking pace.

- Analyze local market trends, seasonality, holidays, and special events.

- Identify underperforming dates and recommend pricing adjustments.

- Monitor competitor pricing and occupancy trends.

- Help maximize revenue without unnecessarily sacrificing occupancy.



**HostBuddy & Rankbreeze Management**

- Regularly monitor and maintain our HostBuddy and Rankbreeze accounts.

- Review performance insights, recommendations, and optimization opportunities within both platforms.

- Update settings, configurations, and listing-related information as needed.

- Identify issues, inconsistencies, or opportunities to improve performance.

- Track changes and monitor their impact on listing visibility, booking conversions, and overall revenue.

- Proactively recommend improvements and ensure both platforms are being utilized effectively.



**Performance Reporting**

- Track listing performance and identify areas needing improvement.

- Provide weekly updates on optimization opportunities, pricing performance, and completed tasks.

- Proactively recommend improvements instead of waiting for instructions.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous hands-on experience managing or optimizing Airbnb and VRBO listings.

- Experience using PriceLabs for dynamic pricing and revenue management.

- Strong understanding of short-term rental pricing, occupancy, and market trends.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and analytical skills.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets, online dashboards, and property management software.



**Preferred Experience**

- HostBuddy and Rankbreeze experience.

- Lodgify or similar property management software.

- AirDNA or other STR analytics and optimization tools.

- Managing multiple vacation rental listings simultaneously.

- Experience in the U.S. vacation rental market.



## How to Apply — IMPORTANT



We receive a large number of applications and want to make sure we spend time getting to know serious, qualified candidates.



**To be considered, you MUST complete ALL 3 steps below. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.**



**STEP 1: Record a Video Introduction (Required)**



Submit a 1–3 minute video introduction of yourself. Your video must include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your professional background.

2. Your specific experience managing or optimizing Airbnb and VRBO listings.

3. Your experience using PriceLabs or similar software, including an example of how you've used it to improve pricing or revenue.

4. Any experience with HostBuddy, Rankbreeze, or similar optimization tools.

5. One specific strategy you would use to improve an underperforming Airbnb listing.



Please speak naturally and explain your actual experience. We are not looking for a scripted sales pitch or an AI-generated response.



**STEP 2: Answer These Questions**



Include the following in your written application:



1. How many Airbnb/VRBO listings have you managed or optimized?

2. How many years of experience do you have with PriceLabs?

3. Have you used HostBuddy or Rankbreeze?(Not a requirement) If so, explain your experience. 

4. What other short-term rental software are you experienced with?

5. What is your desired hourly rate in USD?

6. How many hours per week are you available, and when can you start?



**STEP 3: Follow This Instruction**



Start your application subject line with **"REVOLVE STR EXPERT"** followed by your full name.



Applications without the required video introduction or correct subject line will not be considered.



**What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, and genuinely interested in being part of a team and helping the business grow. Someone who doesn't just complete assigned tasks but actively identifies opportunities to improve our listings and increase revenue.



This position has the potential to grow into a long-term role with increasing pay and additional responsibilities as our company expands.



We look forward to hearing from you!



**Revolve Vacation Rentals**

Scottsdale, Arizona, USA

title: Internal Auditor
description:
The Role

The Internal Auditor will independently test the design and operating effectiveness of financial and operational controls across the company and its real estate portfolio. This role will plan and execute risk-based audits, document findings, and work closely with property, accounting, and asset management teams to identify and remediate control gaps.



This is a high-impact role for someone who can operate independently, apply strong professional judgment, and provide practical recommendations that strengthen controls, improve processes, and mitigate financial and operational risk.



APPLY HERE: 



Key Responsibilities



Audit Planning and Execution

Help build the annual risk assessment and risk-based audit plan.



Plan individual audits, including scope, objectives, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and test programs.



Perform walkthroughs, sample selection, and testing of control design and operating effectiveness.



Prepare clear, well-referenced workpapers that meet IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.



Financial Process and Control Testing

Test controls over financial close, journal entries, account reconciliations, and consolidations.



Audit cash management, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and fund or entity-level accounting.



Test procure-to-pay processes, including vendor setup, purchase approvals, invoice processing, and disbursements.



Support SOX or SOX-like control testing and coordinate with external auditors on reliance work.



Real Estate Operations

Audit lease administration, including lease abstracts, rent rolls, escalations, concessions, and renewals.



Test revenue and receivables, including rent billing, CAM and operating expense reconciliations, tenant recoveries, delinquencies, and write-offs.



Review property management agreements and third-party manager compliance, fees, and reporting.



Audit capital projects and construction, including budgets, change orders, draw requests, retainage, and lien waivers.



Test acquisition and disposition processes, including due diligence, closing statements, and purchase price allocation.



Review security deposits, tenant improvement allowances, and leasing commissions.



Assess property-level controls over petty cash, maintenance spend, and inventory through remote testing and virtual walkthroughs.



Compliance, IT and Fraud Risk

Test IT general controls and application controls in systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or similar platforms.



Evaluate user access, segregation of duties, and system change controls.



Review compliance with loan covenants, partnership and JV agreements, and regulatory requirements.



Assess fraud risk and support special investigations as needed.



Reporting and Follow-Up

Prepare audit reports with clear findings, root causes, risk ratings, and practical recommendations.



Agree remediation plans with process owners and track them through closure.



Present audit results to audit leadership and assist with preparation of Audit Committee materials.



Recommend process improvements, automation, and data analytics opportunities.



Perform other ad hoc duties as requested.



Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.



5+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, Big 4 or regional public accounting, or SOX compliance.



Working knowledge of US GAAP, the COSO framework, and control testing methodologies.



Experience preparing workpapers and audit reports that can withstand external auditor review.



Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data reconciliation.



Experience working independently and managing multiple audits or projects simultaneously.



Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CIA, or CISA certification, or actively pursuing certification.



Real estate industry experience, including REIT, private equity real estate, multifamily, commercial real estate, or property management.



Familiarity with ASC 842 lease accounting, CAM reconciliations, and fund or JV structures.



Experience with real estate systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or similar platforms.



Experience with ERP platforms and financial systems.



Data analytics experience using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, ACL, IDEA, or SQL.



Exposure to construction or capital project audits.



Key Attributes for Success

Independence and objectivity, with sound professional skepticism.



Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.



Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.



Ability to build strong working relationships with property and corporate teams while maintaining an objective position on audit findings.



Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple audits and meet deadlines.



High ethical standards and discretion when handling confidential information.



Ability to identify control weaknesses and develop practical, actionable recommendations.



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with distributed teams.



Work Environment

Fully remote position requiring a reliable internet connection and dedicated workspace.



Ability to work effectively across time zones with distributed teams.



Peak workload may occur around quarter-end, year-end, and external audit cycles.



Perks and Benefits

Professional Development: Opportunities to strengthen internal audit, controls, SOX, and risk management expertise.



Career Growth: Exposure to senior leadership, Audit Committee reporting, and complex financial and operational environments.



Industry Exposure: Gain experience across real estate, accounting, finance, property operations, and corporate functions.



Work Flexibility: Fully remote setup with collaboration tools to stay connected and supported.

title: Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist

Key Attributes for Success

Strong ownership and accountability for the AP function

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Ability to prioritize multiple requests and meet payment and reporting deadlines

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Professional and responsive approach to vendor and internal stakeholder relationships

High level of integrity and discretion when handling financial information

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on identifying and resolving discrepancies

Systems-oriented and comfortable learning new accounting and technology platforms

Commitment to maintaining strong financial controls and accurate accounting records



Perks and Benefits

Professional Development: Ongoing training and exposure to U.S. accounting practices, systems, and processes

Career Growth: Clear progression opportunities within the accounting and finance organization
